column5: These were alternate pasts, he said so himself.{w}\nWhat if someone is a traitor only in some far-off past?{w}\nWe could end up punishing somebody innocent and loyal.
column6: 他说过，那些都是平行的过去。{w}\n如果某人只是在某个遥远的过去里成了叛徒呢？{w}\n我们最终可能会惩罚一个无辜又忠诚的人。

column5: His words were as cryptic as always, especially about cycles.{w}\nI know I wield The Triumvirate's blade, but I am {i}not{/i} like them.{w}\nThis cycle of death, and tyranny, would end by my hand alone.
column6: 他的话一如既往地晦涩，尤其是关于轮回的部分。{w}\n我知道我握着三人执政团的剑，但我{i}不{/i}像他们。{w}\n这死亡与暴政的轮回，将由我一人之手终结。

column5: I look back over my shoulder, and he's still staring into the flames.{w}\nEvery time I talk to him, he tells me something new about his powers.{w}\nAs we approach our final battle however, he'd be more rushed than ever.
column6: 我回头望去，他仍凝视着火焰。{w}\n每次和他交谈，他都会告诉我一些关于他力量的新东西。{w}\n然而随着最终决战临近，他会比以往更加匆忙。

column5: If there were any secrets to be learned, I trust that he could do it.{w}\nBut, as always, a few major questions find themselves at the top of my list.{w}\nWho was The Triumvirate? Why did they require purity? Are there any traitors...?
column6: 若有什么秘密可探，我相信他能做到。{w}\n但一如既往，几个重大问题始终占据我心头首位。{w}\n三人执政团是谁？他们为何要求纯净？可曾有叛徒……？

column5: It seemed that Howl would be the key to solving all of these mysteries, and more.{w}\nThe power that he saw as a curse, was now turning into a bountiful source of hope.
column6: 看来豪尔将是解开这一切谜团乃至更多的关键。{w}\n那被他视为诅咒的力量，如今正化为丰沛的希望之源。

column5: That was the miracle of changing views. Your curses, and your faults, — become strengths.{w}\nAnd if there's anything that would carry us to victory, it would be finding that inner strength.
column6: 那便是观念转变的奇迹。你的诅咒与缺陷——都会化为力量。{w}\n而若有什么能带我们走向胜利，那便是寻得那份内在之力。

column5: The private room is small, and cozy.{w}\nOne lone window provides a view of the arena.{w}\nWe're all able to fit inside without too much discomfort.
column6: 这间私人房间小而舒适。{w}\n一扇孤零零的窗子可以看到竞技场。{w}\n我们所有人都能挤进来，还不算太难受。

column5: Damek seems to be mediating an argument between Ulric and Pro.{w}\nThey look in my direction as I enter, but quickly get back to business.{w}\nGiven the circumstances, it made sense that Ulric and Pro were at odds.
column6: 达梅克似乎在调解乌尔里克和普洛之间的争执。{w}\n我进门时他们朝我这边看了看，但很快又回到正题。{w}\n在这种情况下，乌尔里克和普洛起冲突也在情理之中。

column5: Stop being so stubborn, Ulric!\nWe can do this without killing each other.\nJust focus on the leader, that's all you need to do.
column6: 别这么固执了，乌尔里克！\n我们不杀死对方也能做到的。\n只要集中对付首领就行，你只需要做这个。

column5: I don't think you heard me the first time.\nThere's {i}nothing{/i} I won't do to secure victory.
column6: 我想你第一次没听清。\n为取得胜利，{i}没有什么{/i}是我不会做的。

column5: He takes heavy steps toward Pro, backing him up against the wall.
column6: 他沉重地朝普洛迈步，把他逼到墙边。

column5: That means if I have to kill you — I will.\nAnd there's no way you're going to convince me otherwise.\nThe future of my nation is at stake. Your life means nothing to me.
column6: 那就是说，如果我必须杀了你——我会的。\n你也绝无可能说服我改变主意。\n我国家的未来危在旦夕。你的命对我毫无意义。

column5: He steps away, having made his point.{w}\nDamek interferes, getting in the way of Ulric.
column6: 他把话说清楚了，便退开一步。{w}\n达梅克上前阻拦，挡在乌尔里克面前。

column5: Look, we can figure something out!\nThere's no need for {i}either{/i} of you to die.\nI'll be fighting down there too, so—
column6: 听着，我们总能想出办法的！\n你们{i}两个{/i}都没必要去死。\n我也会在下面战斗，所以——

column5: Ulric quickly cuts him off.
column6: 乌尔里克迅速打断了他。

column5: Stop controlling everything, Damek.\nThis isn't even your army anymore.\nYou need to start acting that way.
column6: 别什么都想管，达梅克。\n这已经不是你的军队了。\n你该开始有点自知之明。

column5: But...
column6: 可是……

column5: No. This army belongs to [firstname].\nHe's the one that will be fighting down there.\nBesides, planning like that is against the rules.
column6: 不。这支军队属于[firstname]。\n下去战斗的人是他。\n再说，那样谋划是违反规矩的。

column5: No. This army belongs to [firstname].\nShe's the one that will be fighting down there.\nBesides, planning like that is against the rules.
column6: 不。这支军队属于[firstname]。\n下去战斗的人是她。\n再说，那样谋划是违反规矩的。

column5: It's a fight to the death, no matter what.\nConspiring to prevent that displays a lack of honor.\nI may want to overthrow this tradition, but I {i}won't{/i} mock it.
column6: 无论如何，这都是生死之战。\n合谋阻止它，是毫无荣誉可言的表现。\n我或许想推翻这个传统，但我{i}不会{/i}去嘲弄它。

column5: He tilts his head toward Draycu, who stands in the corner of the room.
column6: 他朝站在房间角落的德雷库偏了偏头。

column5: Mutual respect. That wasn't something I expected, Ulric.\nThere's nothing I enjoy more than an honorable opponent.\nIt almost makes up for the attempt at crashing my ball.
column6: 互相尊重。这可不是我预料到的，乌尔里克。\n没有什么比一位可敬的对手更让我享受的了。\n这几乎能弥补你试图搞砸我的舞会那件事。

column5: He smirks, a sinister look on his face.
column6: 他嘴角一扬，脸上露出阴险的神情。

column5: But it doesn't mean I'll go easy on you.\nWhere is Vivien, by the way? Did he run?
column6: 但这不代表我会对你手下留情。\n对了，薇薇安在哪儿？他跑了吗？

column5: No. He's in a separate room.\nSomething about meditating before the fight.\nI'd leave him be until it's time to do this.
column6: 不。他在另一个房间里。\n说是要在战斗前冥想。\n在动手之前，我建议别去打扰他。

column5: Speaking of which — may I request some time with my comrades?\nIf the battle is starting soon, then some farewells may be in order.
column6: 说到这个——我能请求和我的战友们单独待一会儿吗？\n如果战斗很快就要开始，或许该做些告别了。

column5: He looks at Pro, as if his words were some sort of threat.
column6: 他看向普洛，仿佛他的话是一种威胁。

column5: Of course. I didn't mean to intrude.\nAs soon as you're ready, we will begin.\nI'll be in the lobby while I wait for you all.
column6: 当然。我无意打扰。\n你们一准备好，我们就开始。\n我会在大厅等你们所有人。

column5: Soon after, we're left alone. Just me and my comrades.{w}\nA tense feeling permeates the air. Things were different, now.{w}\nEven if Ulric and Pro survived, a rift had grown among our ranks.
column6: 不久后，只剩下我们。只有我和我的战友们。{w}\n紧张的气氛弥漫在空气中。如今一切都不同了。{w}\n即便乌尔里克和普洛活下来，我们队伍中也已生出裂痕。

column5: And at this point in time, I'm unsure if we could mend it.{w}\nI gulp, as I wait in silence, and wait for someone to speak.{w}\nIt's Pro. He seems to be acting pretty sensible right now.
column6: 而此时此刻，我不确定我们能否弥合它。{w}\n我咽了口唾沫，沉默地等待着，等有人开口。{w}\n是普洛。他现在看起来相当理智。

column5: Okay, so let's go over this situation before the fight begins.\nWe need to make sure we understand exactly what's going down.\nThe upcoming alliance will ensure our attack on Balteus hits {i}hard{/i}.
column6: 好，那我们在开打之前把局势捋一遍。\n我们得确保自己完全清楚将要发生什么。\n即将结成的同盟将确保我们对巴尔泰乌斯的进攻{i}狠狠{/i}打下去。

column5: I'm fighting alongside Draycu, as his Champion.\nThe fight is over if either him, or myself, fall in combat.\nOur reserve forces will consist of the Monarch Vessels.
column6: 我将作为德雷库的斗士，与他并肩作战。\n只要他或我中有一个倒下，战斗就结束。\n我们的后备力量将由君王容器组成。

column5: I'm fighting alongside Draycu, as his Champion.\nThe fight is over if either him, or myself, fall in combat.\nOur reserve forces will consist of the Created Seers.
column6: 我将作为德雷库的斗士，与他并肩作战。\n只要他或我中有一个倒下，战斗就结束。\n我们的后备力量将由被创造出的先知组成。

column5: [firstname] will also be among those reserve forces, too. \nIf he wins, then Draycu will offer us his might to attack Balteus.\nIf he loses, we get nothing. The pledge lies with him alone.
column6: [firstname]也会在那支后备力量之中。\n如果他赢了，德雷库就会把他的力量借给我们去攻打巴尔泰乌斯。\n如果他输了，我们什么也得不到。那誓言只系于他一人。

column5: On the other hand, Ulric is fighting alongside Vivien, as his Champion.\n[firstname] will fight in Vivien's reserve forces, alongside his army.\nIt may not be as strong as Draycu's, but Vivien isn't about strength.
column6: 另一方面，乌尔里克将作为薇薇安的斗士，与他并肩作战。\n[firstname]将在薇薇安的后备力量中，与他的军队一同战斗。\n那或许不如德雷库的强大，但薇薇安靠的从来不是力量。

column5: If Draycu wins, the nation will stay exactly the same.\nBut if Vivien wins, he will lead Alarinthia in a new direction.\nHopefully, one that allies itself with The New Monarchy.
column6: 如果德雷库赢了，这个国家将一成不变。\n但如果薇薇安赢了，他会带领阿拉林西亚走向新的方向。\n但愿是一个能与新君主国结盟的方向。

column5: Pro crosses his arms.
column6: 普洛抱起双臂。

column5: Someone will die here today.\nEither Vivien, Draycu, myself, or Ulric.\nBut these deaths will not be in vain.
column6: 今天这里会有人死去。\n要么是薇薇安，要么是德雷库，要么是我，要么是乌尔里克。\n但这些牺牲不会白费。

column5: They will give our army incredible strength.\nTheir lives will help us reshape this world.\nOr mine. I'm ready to die for this, too.
column6: 他们会赋予我们军队惊人的力量。\n他们的生命将帮助我们重塑这个世界。\n或者我的。我也准备好为此赴死了。

column5: We wouldn't stand a chance if we attacked Balteus on our own.\nAn alliance is necessary, and this is the best way we can get it.\nOne life — taken here today — is worth it, to change all of Alestia.
column6: 如果仅凭我们自己进攻巴尔泰乌斯，根本毫无胜算。\n同盟是必需的，而这是我们能获得它的最好方式。\n一条今天在此逝去的生命——值得，为了改变整个阿莱斯蒂亚。

column5: To finally take this world back from The Triumvirate.\nWe must simply hope that [firstname] made the right choice.\nIf there even {i}is{/i} a right choice in this type of situation.
column6: 为了最终从三人执政团手中夺回这个世界。\n我们只能希望[firstname]做出了正确的选择。\n在这种局面下，如果{i}真{/i}存在什么正确的选择的话。

column5: For example, our allegiance with Vivien isn't guaranteed.\nIf Dracyu wins, he won't offer us his men. We sided against him.\nThat's a good possibility, given his reputation in the coliseum.
column6: 比如，我们与薇薇安的同盟并非板上钉钉。\n如果德雷库赢了，他不会把他的部下借给我们。我们站到了他的对立面。\n考虑到他在竞技场上的名声，这很有可能。

column5: For example, our allegiance with Draycu isn't guaranteed.\nIf Vivien wins, he won't offer us his men. We sided against him.\nIt's a real possibility, since Ulric is offering Vivien his strength.
column6: 比如，我们与德雷库的同盟并非板上钉钉。\n如果薇薇安赢了，他不会把他的部下借给我们。我们站到了他的对立面。\n这是很有可能的事，因为乌尔里克把力量献给了薇薇安。

column5: Pro is really taking charge here. It's impressive.
column6: 普洛在这里真的挑起了大梁。真令人佩服。

column5: That about sums it up.\nMe, Ulric, and [firstname] need to go to the arena.\nEveryone else will be given seats to watch us fight.
column6: 大致就是这样。\n我、乌尔里克和[firstname]需要去竞技场。\n其余人会被安排座位，观看我们战斗。

column5: If this is the last time I see you all, then goodbye.\nIt was an honor serving you, and fighting for freedom.\nI can only hope that you gain that freedom in the end.
column6: 如果这是我最后一次见到你们所有人，那就再见吧。\n能效忠于你们、为自由而战，是我的荣幸。\n我只能希望，你们最终能赢得那份自由。

column5: He stops talking, and stands in the corner of the room, saying nothing.{w}\nValessa and Fortaime are nodding, as they understand the situation.{w}\nI can tell they were confused before, so his explanation definitely helped.
column6: 他不再说话，站在房间的角落，一言不发。{w}\n瓦莱莎和福泰姆点着头，他们明白了当前的局势。{w}\n看得出他们先前很困惑，所以他的解释显然帮上了忙。

column5: I don't have much to say, I just wanted to get rid of Draycu.\nI'm not very good at farewells, either. So I won't waste your time.\nGood luck in the future. All of you. I hope to see you again.
column6: 我没什么好说的，我只是想把德雷库支开。\n我也不太擅长道别。所以我就不浪费你们的时间了。\n祝你们今后好运。你们所有人。希望还能再见。

column5: He gives us all a slight bow before retreating into another corner.{w}\nThis leaves me with Howl, Damek, Valessa, and Fortaime.
column6: 他朝我们所有人微微一鞠躬，然后退到另一个角落。{w}\n这下只剩下我、豪尔、达梅克、瓦莱莎和福泰姆。

column5: The Monarch Vessels are already waiting by the arena.\nI'll take everyone to our seats, so we can watch you fight.\nI guess it's on you now, [firstname]. Head to the arena.
column6: 君王容器已经在竞技场旁等候了。\n我带大家去我们的座位，好在现场看你们战斗。\n现在就看你的了，[firstname]。去竞技场吧。

column5: The Created Seers are already waiting by the arena.\nI'll take everyone to our seats, so we can watch you fight.\nI guess it's on you now, [firstname]. Head to the arena.
column6: 被创造出的先知已经在竞技场旁等候了。\n我带大家去我们的座位，好在现场看你们战斗。\n现在就看你的了，[firstname]。去竞技场吧。

column5: Do you really need to rush into it like this?\nCan't you take some time to prepare, and train?
column6: 你真的有必要这么急着去吗？\n就不能花点时间准备和训练吗？

column5: That would be impossible.\nAlarinthia takes these battles very seriously.\nDelaying it would insult the honor of all participants.
column6: 那不可能。\n阿拉林西亚对这些战斗极为重视。\n拖延会侮辱所有参与者的荣誉。

column5: Screw honor, then!\nI'm not ready to say goodbye just yet.\nThere's still so much we need to do...!
column6: 荣誉什么的见鬼去吧！\n我还没准备好说再见。\n我们还有很多事要做……！

column5: I shake my head. There's no point trying to delay this.{w}\nWhatever happened, happened. I wouldn't be the tipping point.{w}
column6: 我摇了摇头。拖延毫无意义。{w}\n发生过的事已经发生了。我也不会成为那个转折点。{w}

column5: Then don't say goodbye.\nSimply hope that he survives this battle.\nCheer him on from the sidelines. Support him.
column6: 那就别说再见。\n只需希望他能在这场战斗中活下来。\n在场边为他加油。支持他。

column5: Then don't say goodbye.\nSimply hope that she survives this battle.\nCheer her on from the sidelines. Support her.
column6: 那就别说再见。\n只需希望她能在这场战斗中活下来。\n在场边为她加油。支持她。

column5: I guess that's all we can really do...\nThings will work out for the best. I know it.\nWe're due for some good luck by now.
column6: 我想我们也只能做这么多了……\n一切都会往好的方向发展。我知道的。\n我们也该转运了。

column5: Should we go take our seats...?
column6: 我们是不是该去入座了……？

column5: Yeah. We probably should.\nMonarch...? Good luck.
column6: 嗯。大概该去了。\n君主……？祝你好运。

column5: He smiles at me before leaving the room.{w}\nI guess not treating this as a goodbye helped them.{w}\nIt made them feel like they'd be seeing us all again.
column6: 他冲我笑了笑，然后离开了房间。{w}\n我想，不把这当成告别，对他们是有帮助的。{w}\n这让他们觉得还会再见到我们。

column5: I wish I could guarantee that, I really do.{w}\nValessa, Fortaime, and Howl soon follow suit.{w}\nI'm left here with Ulric and Pro. They're silent.
column6: 我真希望能保证这一点，真的。{w}\n瓦莱莎、福泰姆和豪尔也很快跟着出去了。{w}\n这里只剩下我、乌尔里克和普洛。他们一言不发。

column5: There's no point in bickering at the gates of death.{w}\nPerhaps they've simply accepted what's coming.{w}\nThis battle would start when I went to the arena.
column6: 在死亡之门前争吵毫无意义。{w}\n也许他们只是接受了即将到来的一切。{w}\n这场战斗会在我前往竞技场时开始。

column5: The battle that decided the fate of a nation.{w}\nAnd by extension, the fate of our entire world.{w}\nThis is the first time I felt the weight of my role.
column6: 一场决定国家命运的战斗。{w}\n进而，也决定着整个世界的命运。{w}\n这是我第一次感受到自己这个身份的分量。

column5: I'm The Monarch. I'm shaping a world that I'll go on to rule.{w}\nThat is — if I survive the battle in the coliseum, and in Balteus.{w}\nIt was time to take charge. I'd go to the arena, and end this.
column6: 我是君主。我正在塑造一个我将来要统治的世界。{w}\n前提是——我能在大竞技场和巴尔泰乌斯的战斗中活下来。{w}\n该扛起责任了。我要去竞技场，结束这一切。

column5: Whether I lived or died, I'd make my mark upon this world.
column6: 无论生死，我都要在这个世界留下我的印记。
