column5: A window overlooks the entire arena.{w}\nThe seats are all full, and people are talking.{w}\nI can't believe so many people would be watching us.
column6: 一扇窗俯瞰着整座竞技场。{w}\n座位全满了，人们交谈着。{w}\n真不敢相信会有这么多人来观看我们。

column5: It's a book about The Grand Library in Balteus.
column6: 这是一本关于巴尔泰乌斯大图书馆的书。

column5: There's a book and a sword sitting here.{w}\nBetween the two, a small dagger rests there.{w}\nI go to touch it, but Pro quickly stops me.
column6: 这里放着一本书和一把剑。{w}\n在两者之间，还搁着一把小小的匕首。{w}\n我伸手去碰，普洛却迅速拦住了我。

column5: Hey, don't touch that! It's mine!\nI plan to use it during the upcoming battle.\nNever touch a weapon that's not your own.
column6: 嘿，别碰那个！那是我的！\n我打算在接下来的战斗里用它。\n永远别碰不属于你的武器。

column5: I apologize, and set my sights to the book.{w}\nIt seems to be about The Grand Library in Balteus.{w}\nWhy was this here? Was somebody studying it...?
column6: 我道了歉，把目光转向那本书。{w}\n它似乎讲的是巴尔泰乌斯的大图书馆。{w}\n它为什么会在这里？有人在研究它吗……？

column5: I approach Pro, who remains standing in the corner of the room.{w}\nIt looks like he's scared, or nervous, but that's understandable.{w}\nIn mere moments, we'd be fighting for the future of our army.
column6: 我走向仍站在房间角落的普洛。{w}\n他看起来像是害怕，或是紧张，但这可以理解。{w}\n片刻之后，我们就要为我们军队的未来而战。

column5: A few moments after my steps come to an end, Pro looks at me.{w}\nSorrow appears on his face, and it looks like he's filled with regret.
column6: 我停下脚步片刻后，普洛看向我。{w}\n他脸上浮现出悲伤，看起来满心懊悔。

column5: Look, I'm sorry for making things complicated.\nI've been getting looks from everybody. They hate me.\nI put my life at risk, and foolishly offered our own army.
column6: 听着，很抱歉把事情搞得这么复杂。\n所有人都用那种眼神看我。他们恨我。\n我拿自己的命去冒险，还愚蠢地献出了我们自己的军队。

column5: We need that army for our final attack on Balteus.\nEverybody thinks I've condemned us to death, but it's not true!\nThis situation is super complicated, and their vision is so narrow.
column6: 我们需要那支军队来做对巴尔泰乌斯的最终一击。\n所有人都觉得我把我们送上了死路，但不是那样的！\n这局势超级复杂，而他们的眼光太狭隘了。

column5: I wish this didn't have to happen right now.\nEspecially after that moment we shared on the boat.\nI'm guessing that this is it for us, isn't it, [firstname]...?
column6: 我真希望这事不必现在发生。\n尤其是在我们在船上共度的那一刻之后。\n我猜我们之间就到此为止了，是吗，[firstname]……？

column5: I wish this didn't have to happen right now.\nEspecially after we've been growing closer as friends.\nI'm guessing that this is it for our friendship, isn't it...?
column6: 我真希望这事不必现在发生。\n尤其是在我们作为朋友越走越近之后。\n我猜我们的友谊就到此为止了，是吗……？

column5: I knew it. You're just like all the rest.\nI'm sorry for doing this, but I wish you trusted me.\nIt's not what you think. I'm not really this reckless.
column6: 我就知道。你和其余的人一样。\n很抱歉我这么做，但我希望你能相信我。\n事情不是你想的那样。我其实没那么鲁莽。

column5: But I understand why you don't want to deal with me anymore.\nIn the future, I'll keep our interaction to the bare minimum.\nNo need to mix business with pleasure anymore, right?
column6: 但我理解你为什么不想再理我了。\n今后，我会把我们的来往降到最低限度。\n没必要再把公事和私情混在一起了，对吧？

column5: I can tell that he's crushed, but it had to be done.{w}\nHe betrayed our entire cause with his foolish actions.{w}\nThere's no telling how many of our forces would die.
column6: 我看得出他深受打击，但这是必须的。{w}\n他愚蠢的举动背叛了我们整个事业。{w}\n说不准我们会有多少兵力因此丧命。

column5: I know I sided with Draycu, but that was beside the point.{w}\nI would've regardless. Pro played right into Draycu's hand.{w}\nIf he let me handle it, neither him, or our army would be in danger.
column6: 我知道我站在了德雷库那边，但那不是重点。{w}\n无论如何我都会那么做。普洛正好落入了德雷库的圈套。{w}\n如果他让我来处理，他和我们的军队都不会陷入危险。

column5: He walks away from me, visibly upset and angry.{w}\nIt was funny how a friendship could come to an end so easily.{w}\nBut if I was going to rule this world, I had to learn to put my foot down.
column6: 他离开我身边，显然又伤心又愤怒。{w}\n一段友谊竟能如此轻易地走到尽头，真是可笑。{w}\n但如果我要统治这个世界，我就得学会态度强硬。

column5: Your bond with Pro was irreparably damaged.{w}\nYou will be unable to access his Loyalty Scene in the future.{w}\nThis brings Pro's series of Heart-to-Hearts to an indefinite close.
column6: 你与普洛的羁绊已被无法修复地破坏。{w}\n今后你将无法解锁他的忠诚剧情。{w}\n普洛的一系列“心灵相通”就此无限期搁置。

column5: Wait, seriously...? Thank you!\nI was so scared you'd cut things off.\nI really value our bond, [firstname]. I swear.
column6: 等等，真的吗……？谢谢你！\n我特别怕你会就此断绝关系。\n我真的很珍惜我们的羁绊，[firstname]。我发誓。

column5: I knew we'd be able to push through this.\nThe fact that you sided with Draycu convinced me.\nEven in all the confusion, we still see eye to eye.
column6: 我就知道我们能挺过这一关。\n你站在德雷库那边这件事让我确信了。\n即便在一切混乱之中，我们依然心意相通。

column5: We can work together to take down Vivien.\nAnd we'll also work together to keep our forces safe.\nIt was the best possible decision. I know it. You know it.
column6: 我们可以联手击败薇薇安。\n我们也会联手保护好我们的军队。\n这是最好的决定。我知道，你也知道。

column5: You sided with Vivien, so this was a total gamble.\nIt's good to know that we can endure a difference in opinion\nUlric wasn't giving me the same courtesy. I think he'd even kill me.
column6: 你站在了薇薇安那边，所以这完全是场豪赌。\n很高兴知道我们能容忍意见分歧。\n乌尔里克可没给我同样的礼遇。我觉得他甚至会杀了我。

column5: But I guess I can understand why he'd do that.\nThis isn't just about an alliance to him. This is his home.\nHe wants to change it for the better, like we all do with Alestia.
column6: 但我想我能理解他为什么会那样做。\n对他来说，这不仅仅关乎同盟。这是他的家乡。\n他想把它变得更好，就像我们所有人都想改变阿莱斯蒂亚一样。

column5: I know this whole situation is really confusing.\nTo be honest, I don't even know every little detail.\nBut as long as we all trust each other, it'll work out.
column6: 我知道这整个局面确实很让人困惑。\n老实说，我甚至不清楚每一个细节。\n但只要我们彼此信任，一切都会好起来的。

column5: He takes a few steps, closing the distance between us.{w}\nHis eyes are filled with hope now, a stark contrast to moments ago.
column6: 他迈了几步，缩短了我们之间的距离。{w}\n此刻他眼中满是希望，与片刻前判若两人。

column5: Thank you so much, [firstname].\nI know there isn't much time, so we need to get going.\nBut that's all I needed to talk about. I'm good to go.
column6: 太谢谢你了，[firstname]。\n我知道时间不多了，我们得动身了。\n但我要说的就这些。我准备好了。

column5: He wraps his arms around me, and rests his head against my shoulder.
column6: 他张开双臂抱住我，把头靠在我的肩上。

column5: We'll make it through this, I know it.\nYou may not understand, but I promise you will.\nJust give it time. I know I'd happily give you all of mine.
column6: 我们会挺过去的，我知道。\n你也许现在不明白，但我保证你会的。\n给点时间就好。我知道我会乐意把我所有的时间都给你。

column5: After this battle, we'll have a long chat.\nThere's so much I need to tell you, but I just can't right now.\nI promise that at the end of the day, this will all make sense.
column6: 这场战斗之后，我们好好长谈一次。\n我有太多事要告诉你，但现在实在不行。\n我保证，到最后这一切都会说得通的。

column5: He smiles, and runs off to the lobby.{w}\nI guess it was time. We'd finally do this.{w}\nI'm thankful that our bond remains intact.
column6: 他笑了笑，跑向大厅。{w}\n我想时候到了。我们终于要动手了。{w}\n我很感激我们的羁绊依然完好。

column5: Pro's loyalty scene will be available when you return to the mainland.{w}\nAfter the conclusion of Act Four, return to the Rebel HQ War Table.
column6: 当你回到大陆时，普洛的忠诚剧情将会开放。{w}\n第四幕结束后，回到反抗军总部的作战桌。

column5: After this battle, we'll have a long chat.\nThere's so much I need to tell you, but I just can't right now.\nI promise that at the end of the day, this will all make sense.
column6: 这场战斗之后，我们好好长谈一次。\n我有太多事要告诉你，但现在实在不行。\n我保证，到最后这一切都会说得通的。

column5: He smiles, and makes his way out of the room.{w}\nI guess it was time. The fight would finally begin.{w}\nI'm glad that my bond with Pro could remain intact.
column6: 他笑了笑，走出了房间。{w}\n我想时候到了。战斗终于要开始了。{w}\n我很高兴我与普洛的羁绊得以完好保留。

column5: Pro's loyalty scene will be available when you return to the mainland.{w}\nAfter the conclusion of Act Four, return to the Rebel HQ War Table.
column6: 当你回到大陆时，普洛的忠诚剧情将会开放。{w}\n第四幕结束后，回到反抗军总部的作战桌。

column5: I enter the lobby, with Ulric and Pro behind me.{w}\nOur comrades are there, and they immediately turn and stare.{w}\nAn odd aura fills the air. But this definitely {i}is{/i} an odd situation.
column6: 我走进大厅，乌尔里克和普洛跟在我身后。{w}\n我们的战友们都在那里，他们立刻转头盯着我们。{w}\n一股古怪的气氛弥漫开来。但这确实{i}是{/i}个古怪的局面。

column5: Draycu stands on one side of the room, and Vivien stands on another.{w}\nPro follows me as I take slow steps toward Draycu, my ally in this battle.{w}\nIf I wanted to win, I'd have to ensure that him and Pro stayed alive.
column6: 德雷库站在房间的一侧，薇薇安站在另一侧。{w}\n我缓缓朝德雷库——我这场战斗中的盟友——走去，普洛跟在我身后。{w}\n若我想获胜，就必须确保他和普洛都活着。

column5: So, the battle is about to begin.\nBoth teams will enter the coliseum on opposite sides.\nWhen we meet in the middle, chaos will ensue.
column6: 那么，战斗即将开始。\n两支队伍将从对侧进入大竞技场。\n当我们在中央相遇时，混乱就会爆发。

column5: This chaos will involve the death of many people.\nI hope that you've said your potential goodbyes, [firstname].\nI'll do my best to support you, but I need to focus on my own safety.
column6: 这场混乱会夺走许多人的性命。\n希望你已经把该道的别都道过了，[firstname]。\n我会尽力支援你，但我也得顾好自己的安危。

column5: I nod, since that's completely understandable.
column6: 我点了点头，这完全可以理解。

column5: Besides, I think you'll be fine.\nI've heard rumors of that sword you're carrying.\nIf I get into a pinch, I might even count on your support.
column6: 再说，我觉得你不会有事的。\n我听说过你带着的那把剑的传闻。\n要是我陷入困境，说不定还得指望你来支援。

column5: He places his hand on my shoulder, and smiles.
column6: 他把手搭在我肩上，笑了笑。

column5: That is, if we even run into each other out there.\nIt's a big arena, and it'll be full of soldiers.\nLet's get going. We're on the other side.
column6: 当然，前提是我们在场上能碰上。\n竞技场很大，而且会挤满士兵。\n走吧。我们在另一边。

column5: My comrades all make their way to the spectator's area.{w}\nAfter that, both Leaders escort their forces to the waiting area.{w}\nAs soon as the gates were lifted, the battle for Alarinthia would begin.
column6: 我的战友们纷纷前往观众区。{w}\n之后，两位领袖各自率领部队前往等候区。{w}\n闸门一升起，争夺阿拉林西亚的战斗就将开始。

column5: I notice the reserve forces we lent Draycu in the corner of my eye.{w}\nThey approach me as we walk, and give me wishes of support.
column6: 我眼角瞥见我们借给德雷库的后备部队。{w}\n我们走着时他们围了上来，向我表达支持与祝愿。

column5: We will use our power to protect you.\nDo not worry, and simply give it your all.
column6: 我们会用我们的力量保护你。\n不必担心，只管全力以赴。

column5: However, we haven't exactly mastered this power.\nSo don't rely on us to keep you out of harm's way.
column6: 不过，我们还没有完全掌握这股力量。\n所以别指望我们能让你远离危险。

column5: If we survive this, we will continue to grow our gift.\nOur goal is to be of use during the final assault on Balteus.
column6: 如果我们能活下来，我们会继续培育这份天赋。\n我们的目标是在对巴尔泰乌斯的最终进攻中派上用场。

column5: I nod. It's good to know that I have their support.{w}\nBut I wish we didn't have to put them in danger right now.{w}\nTheir power would be more useful in the coming days.
column6: 我点了点头。知道有他们的支持是好事。{w}\n但我真希望我们不必现在就让他们身陷险境。{w}\n他们的力量在接下来的日子里会更有用。

column5: Do not worry. We will aid you in this battle.\nIf you stay by our side, you will see no harm.
column6: 不必担心。我们会在这场战斗中助你一臂之力。\n只要你待在我们身边，就不会受伤。

column5: It is unlikely that these bodies will perish.\nAfter this, we will also protect you in Balteus.
column6: 这些躯体不太可能消亡。\n这之后，我们也会在巴尔泰乌斯保护你。

column5: Allow us this chance to repay you.\nYou gave us life, and now we can be of use.
column6: 请允许我们借此机会报答你。\n你赋予了我们生命，如今我们能派上用场了。

column5: I nod. It's good to know that I have their support.{w}\nBut I wish we did't have to put them in danger right now.{w}\nTheir power would be more useful in the coming days.
column6: 我点了点头。知道有他们的支持是好事。{w}\n但我真希望我们不必现在就让他们身陷险境。{w}\n他们的力量在接下来的日子里会更有用。

column5: Vivien stands on one side of the room, and Draycu stands on another.{w}\nUlric follows me as I take slow steps toward Vivien, my ally in this battle.{w}\nIf I wanted to win, I'd have to ensure that him and Ulric stayed alive.
column6: 薇薇安站在房间的一侧，德雷库站在另一侧。{w}\n我缓缓朝薇薇安——我这场战斗中的盟友——走去，乌尔里克跟在我身后。{w}\n若我想获胜，就必须确保他和乌尔里克都活着。

column5: So, it's finally going to happen.\nI've been dreaming about this day for a long time.\nDo your best out there, Monarch. I've got your back.
column6: 那么，终于要开始了。\n我梦想这一天已经很久了。\n在外面尽力而为吧，君主。我会罩着你的。

column5: Of course, I {i}have{/i} heard rumors about that blade you're carrying.\nSo if you don't mind — I might choose to lean on you for support, too.\nIf we all take care of each other, then we'll be unstoppable for sure.
column6: 当然，我{i}确实{/i}听说过你带着的那把剑的传闻。\n所以如果你不介意——我或许也会选择倚仗你的支援。\n如果我们都互相照应，那我们肯定无人能挡。

column5: I nod, since he's right.
column6: 我点了点头，因为他说得对。

column5: We need to make our way to the other side of the coliseum.\nBoth groups start on opposite ends, and meet in the middle.\nThat's where all the chaos ensues. It'll be pretty hectic.
column6: 我们得前往大竞技场的另一端。\n两支队伍从两端出发，在中央相遇。\n混乱就在那里爆发。会相当激烈。

column5: I'm counting on it. It's been ages since I've seen a real battle.\nDo your best to stay out of danger, [firstname]. Leave this to us.\nThere's no need for you to risk your life unless you need to.
column6: 我可就指望这个了。我已经很久没见过真正的战斗了。\n尽量别陷入危险，[firstname]。交给我们。\n除非必要，你没必要拿命去冒险。

column5: Our targets are Draycu and Pro.\nWe should do our best to avoid senseless casualties.\nViven's reign should begin with as little bloodshed as possible.
column6: 我们的目标是德雷库和普洛。\n我们应尽力避免无谓的伤亡。\n薇薇安的统治应当以尽可能少的流血开始。

column5: I nod, and watch as Vivien and Ulric shake hands.
column6: 我点了点头，看着薇薇安和乌尔里克握手。

column5: It's a bit of a walk, so lets get started.\nThe battle will start in a few minutes, so we need to be there.\nSome leader I'd be if I showed up late to my own fight.
column6: 有一段路要走，所以出发吧。\n战斗几分钟后就开始，我们得赶到那儿。\n要是连自己的战斗都迟到，我还算什么领袖。

column5: He smiles, and we break our huddle.{w}\nI follow him as we make our way to the gates.{w}\nThe weight on my shoulders is immense, and frightening.
column6: 他笑了笑，我们结束了围聚。{w}\n我跟在他身后，朝闸门走去。{w}\n我肩上的重担无比巨大，令人恐惧。

column5: I notice Drakeor make his way to my side.{w}\nHe looks me up and down, staring at my blade.
column6: 我注意到德雷克奥尔走到我身边。{w}\n他上下打量着我，目光盯着我的剑。

column5: Look, I don't know if what they told me was true.\nBut if that blade is some sort of ancient relic, don't showboat.\nAnything other than strength and strategy will be seen as cheating.
column6: 听着，我不知道他们告诉我的是不是真的。\n但如果那把剑是什么古代遗物，别炫耀。\n除力量与策略之外的任何东西都会被视作作弊。

column5: That blade may have powers to help you out in Balteus, but not here.\nDo your best to blend in as a regular combatant, alright...?\nI don't want you putting Vivien in jeopardy out there.
column6: 那把剑或许有力量能在巴尔泰乌斯帮你，但在这里不行。\n尽量像个普通战士一样混在里面，行吗……？\n我不想你在场上危及薇薇安。

column5: I shrug, since I don't really have a say in the matter.{w}\nI suppose the powers of the blade were pretty much cheating.{w}\nA thrown battle would do little to prove Vivien's credibility.
column6: 我耸了耸肩，毕竟这事我没什么发言权。{w}\n我想那剑的力量确实跟作弊差不多。{w}\n一场放水的战斗对证明薇薇安的信誉毫无帮助。

column5: After a trek that seems like forever, we're at our gates.{w}\nThey're shut tight, and I can see another set across from this one.{w}\nAt the other end of the arena, our opponents were waiting, just like us.
column6: 经过仿佛永无止境的跋涉，我们来到了自己的闸门前。{w}\n门紧紧关着，我能看到对面还有另一组闸门。{w}\n在竞技场的另一端，我们的对手正像我们一样等待着。

column5: I look over at my allies, and gulp.{w}\nThe crowd is roaring with excitement.{w}\nOur lives were simply entertainment to them.
column6: 我看向我的盟友，咽了口唾沫。{w}\n人群兴奋地吼叫着。{w}\n我们的性命对他们来说不过是娱乐。

column5: Don't worry. We can do this.\nWe only have a few more seconds, so get ready.\nIf this is like any other battle, it'll only last a few minutes.
column6: 别担心。我们能行的。\n只剩几秒钟了，准备好吧。\n如果这跟其他战斗一样，只会持续几分钟。

column5: See? I told you we picked the right guy.\nThis'll be over before you know it, and we'll be the winners.\nAfter this, our attack on Balteus will be a cakewalk. I know it.
column6: 看吧？我说过我们选对人了。\n转眼就会结束，而我们会是赢家。\n这之后，我们对巴尔泰乌斯的进攻会易如反掌。我确信。

column5: Remember, we're fighting for a better future.\nOur hopes and dreams will carry us to victory. I know it.\nOf course, Ulric's sword arm will sure be a big help.
column6: 记住，我们是为更美好的未来而战。\n我们的希望与梦想会带我们走向胜利。我确信。\n当然，乌尔里克那身剑术肯定能派上大用场。

column5: No need to put on the pressure, Vivien.\nBut I know you're right. This is all I've ever wanted.\nAnd with you two by my side, I know I'll never fail.
column6: 不用给我施压，薇薇安。\n但我知道你说得对。这是我一直以来想要的。\n有你们两个在我身边，我知道我绝不会失败。

column5: He smiles, but that smile is quickly wiped from his face.
column6: 他笑了，但那笑容很快从他脸上消失。

column5: The gates begin to open, giving us a clear view of the arena.
column6: 闸门开始打开，让我们清楚地看到竞技场。

column5: We take a few steps outside of the gates, and look around.{w}\nThe crowd goes wild, and that's when all hell breaks loose.{w}\nThe reserve forces rush to the center to create a line of defense.
column6: 我们走出闸门几步，环顾四周。{w}\n人群疯狂起来，就在这时，一切都乱了套。{w}\n后备部队冲往中央，筑起一道防线。

column5: Stay back, [firstname]!\nLet them get things started...!
column6: 退后，[firstname]！\n让他们先开个头……！

column5: No, this is the perfect time to charge!\nThe cover of chaos will help us catch them off guard.
column6: 不，这正是冲锋的最佳时机！\n混乱的掩护能帮我们打他们个措手不及。

column5: R-right!
column6: 好、好的！

column5: Stay back, [firstname]!\nLet me and Vivien lead the charge!
column6: 退后，[firstname]！\n让我和薇薇安带头冲锋！

column5: Yeah, just make sure to stay out of danger.\nWe can't have our future ruler falling in battle!
column6: 对，千万注意别陷入危险。\n我们可不能让我们未来的统治者倒在战场上！

column5: Now...!
column6: 现在……！

column5: I stay back as instructed, and let them lead the charge.{w}\nAfter a few minutes, everybody meets in the center.{w}\nAll I hear is clashing metal, and agonizing screams.
column6: 我按照吩咐留在后面，让他们带头冲锋。{w}\n几分钟后，所有人都汇聚到了中央。{w}\n我只听到金属的碰撞声和痛苦的惨叫。

column5: It's an absolute massacre. Just like...
column6: 这完全是一场屠杀。就像……

column5: I gasp and take a few steps back, anxiety coursing through me.{w}\nIt feels like I'm right back in the Rebel HQ. Everybody is dying...!{w}\nI clutch my chest, and start to panic in the arena, my breath short.
column6: 我喘了口气，后退了几步，焦虑涌遍全身。{w}\n感觉就像我又回到了反抗军总部。所有人都在死去……！{w}\n我捂住胸口，在竞技场里开始惊慌失措，呼吸困难。

column5: What's going on!? This has never happened before...{w}\nI can't escape this. It feels like it's happening all over again.{w}\nI shake my head, but nothing helps. I need it to stop...!
column6: 这是怎么回事！？以前从没发生过……{w}\n我逃不开。感觉就像一切又重演了。{w}\n我摇了摇头，但毫无帮助。我需要它停下来……！

column5: Hey [firstname], you okay...?
column6: 嘿，[firstname]，你还好吗……？

column5: I'm unable to respond, as enemy soldiers close in on me.
column6: 我无法回应，因为敌兵正朝我逼近。

column5: [firstname]...!
column6: [firstname]……！

column5: Pro rushes to my side and pushes me on the ground.{w}\nI hit the ground with a loud thud, and I'm knocked back into coherence.{w}\nHowever, this did little else but redirect the attention to him.
column6: 普洛冲到我身边，把我推倒在地。{w}\n我砰地一声摔在地上，被震得恢复了意识。{w}\n然而，这除了把注意力引到他身上之外，几乎毫无作用。

column5: Hey [firstname], are you okay...?
column6: 嘿，[firstname]，你还好吗……？

column5: I'm unable to respond as enemy soldiers close in on me.{w}\nDraycu's reserve forces, our own men, are coming to attack me.{w}\nOr were they? I had no idea if they'd actually follow through.
column6: 我无法回应，因为敌兵正朝我逼近。{w}\n德雷库的后备部队——我们自己的人——正朝我攻来。{w}\n还是说，他们真会动手？我根本不知道他们会不会真的照做。

column5: And thanks to a sudden interruption, I'd never find out.
column6: 而由于一次突如其来的打断，我永远也不会知道了。

column5: [firstname]!
column6: [firstname]！

column5: Ulric rushes to my side and pushes me on the ground.{w}\nI hit the floor with a loud thud, and I'm knocked back into coherence.{w}\nHowever, this did little else but redirect the attention to him.
column6: 乌尔里克冲到我身边，把我推倒在地。{w}\n我砰地一声摔在地上，被震得恢复了意识。{w}\n然而，这除了把注意力引到他身上之外，几乎毫无作用。

column5: With almost a dozen men charging toward him, he starts to panic.{w}\nLuckily, he's saved by Draycu moments before they can harm him.{w}\nWith a swing of a large greatsword, they're all knocked down.
column6: 将近十几个人朝他冲来，他开始慌了。{w}\n幸好，就在他们即将伤到他之前，德雷库救下了他。{w}\n一记巨剑挥过，他们全被击倒在地。

column5: Going after my Champion, huh...?\nVivien's men must have a death wish.\nHere [firstname], let me help you up.
column6: 冲我的斗士下手，是吧……？\n薇薇安的手下想必是活腻了。\n来，[firstname]，我扶你起来。

column5: With almost a dozen men charging toward him, he stands his ground.{w}\nUnsheathing his sword, he sizes up the oncoming attackers.{w}\nOne single swing later, they're all knocked to the ground.
column6: 将近十几个人朝他冲来，他岿然不动。{w}\n他拔出剑，打量着冲来的攻击者。{w}\n只一挥，他们全被击倒在地。

column5: It seems he's shown them mercy, as they squirm on the ground, injured.
column6: 他似乎对他们手下留情了，因为他们只是受了伤，在地上扭动。

column5: I'm not sure what he was calculating, but that was impressive.{w}\nIt's almost like he knew exactly when to swing for maximum effect.{w}\nIt hurts me to see him harm our own, but there was no other choice.
column6: 我不确定他在盘算什么，但那确实令人叹服。{w}\n简直就像他精确知道何时挥剑才能达到最大效果。{w}\n看他伤害我们自己的人让我心痛，但别无选择。

column5: Forgive me, [firstname].\nIt was either them or you. I had to make a decision.\nGive me your hand, we need to keep things moving.
column6: 原谅我，[firstname]。\n不是他们就是你。我必须做出决定。\n把手给我，我们得继续推进。

column5: I nod, and grab his hand. He helps me back on my feet.{w}\nI have no idea what just happened. Was that a vision, or something else?{w}\nNo — there was no time to think about that. We had a battle to focus on.
column6: 我点了点头，抓住他的手。他把我扶了起来。{w}\n我完全不知道刚才发生了什么。那是幻象，还是别的什么？{w}\n不——没时间想这个了。我们还有一场战斗要专心应对。

column5: And it was a battle that we were winning.
column6: 而这是一场我们正在赢下的战斗。

column5: We push the opposing forces back toward their side.{w}\nAfter a few minutes of battle, they're almost backed into a corner.{w}\nWe had them right where we wanted them. Or did we...?
column6: 我们把敌军逼退回他们那一侧。{w}\n战斗了几分钟后，他们几乎被逼到了角落。{w}\n他们完全落入了我们想要的境地。真的是这样吗……？

column5: Now...!
column6: 现在……！

column5: Just when we think we have the upper hand, Vivien plays his trump card.{w}\nHis forces spread out, and quickly run around our flank, surrounding us.{w}\nWe weren't quick enough to react, we were all too close together.
column6: 就在我们以为占了上风时，薇薇安打出了他的王牌。{w}\n他的部队散开，迅速绕到我们的侧翼，将我们包围。{w}\n我们反应不够快，大家又挤得太近。

column5: Stay close! \nIf we can get through this, then we'll win.\nIt looks like this was his plan all along.
column6: 靠紧点！\n只要我们能挺过这一关，我们就赢了。\n看来这就是他一直以来的计划。

column5: They take slow, synchronized steps toward us.{w}\nWe all look for a weakness, but can't find any.{w}\nIn a few minutes, they'd close in on us.
column6: 他们迈着缓慢而整齐的步伐朝我们逼近。{w}\n我们都在寻找破绽，却一个也找不到。{w}\n再过几分钟，他们就会合围上来。

column5: Yeah, this strategy reeks of desperation.\nGet us out of this, [firstname]. Use that blade if you have to.\nThere's no way he has more up his sleeve. Not after this.
column6: 是啊，这策略透着一股孤注一掷的味道。\n带我们脱困，[firstname]。不得已就用那把剑。\n他不可能还有后手了。这一招之后不可能。

column5: They raise their blades, and ready themselves to attack.{w}\nThey're still far away, but it's enough to intimidate us.{w}\nI reach for my own weapon in response, and unsheathe it.
column6: 他们举起兵刃，准备进攻。{w}\n他们离得还远，但已足以让我们心生畏惧。{w}\n我伸手握住自己的武器作为回应，将它拔出。

column5: Now...!
column6: 现在……！

column5: Just when we think we have the upper hand, Draycu plays his trump card.{w}\nHis forces spread out, and quickly run around our flank, surrounding us.{w}\nWe weren't quick enough to react, we were all too close together.
column6: 就在我们以为占了上风时，德雷库打出了他的王牌。{w}\n他的部队散开，迅速绕到我们的侧翼，将我们包围。{w}\n我们反应不够快，大家又挤得太近。

column5: Stay close, [firstname]!\nThis must be what Draycu was counting on.\nIf we can break free, then victory is surely ours.
column6: 靠紧点，[firstname]！\n这一定是德雷库所指望的。\n如果我们能突围，胜利就必然属于我们。

column5: They take slow, synchronized steps toward us.{w}\nWe all look for a weakness, but can't find any.{w}\nIn a few minutes, they'd close in on us.
column6: 他们迈着缓慢而整齐的步伐朝我们逼近。{w}\n我们都在寻找破绽，却一个也找不到。{w}\n再过几分钟，他们就会合围上来。

column5: This strategy, it seems desperate.\nThat means he doesn't have anything else up his sleeve.\nGet us out of this, [firstname]! Use that blade if you have to.
column6: 这策略，看起来是走投无路了。\n那就意味着他没有别的后手了。\n带我们脱困，[firstname]！不得已就用那把剑。

column5: They raise their blades, and ready themselves to attack.{w}\nThey're still far away, but it's enough to intimidate us.{w}\nI reach for my own weapon in response, and unsheathe it.
column6: 他们举起兵刃，准备进攻。{w}\n他们离得还远，但已足以让我们心生畏惧。{w}\n我伸手握住自己的武器作为回应，将它拔出。

column5: I take slow steps forward, matching their synchronization.{w}\nThey stare at me, confused, and some of them even scoff at me.{w}\nThis was my chance to shine. I had to save us all from this trap.
column6: 我缓缓向前迈步，配合着他们整齐的节奏。{w}\n他们困惑地盯着我，有些人甚至嗤笑起来。{w}\n这是我发光的机会。我必须把大家从这个陷阱里救出来。

column5: Gripping the blade tightly, I try and figure out how to “activate” it.{w}\nAs if sensing my instinct, the gear on the base starts to spin fervently.{w}\nI raise it up in the air, and demand that the blade assist us in battle.
column6: 我紧紧握住剑刃，试图弄明白该如何“激活”它。{w}\n仿佛感应到我的意念，剑柄底部的齿轮开始疯狂转动。{w}\n我将它高举空中，命令剑刃在战斗中助我们一臂之力。

column5: Immediately after that, a flash of white light overtakes the arena.{w}\nJust like every other time the Blade has been used. As if that's its call.{w}\nHowever, this flash of white light subsides almost as soon as it began.
column6: 就在那之后，一道白光席卷了整座竞技场。{w}\n和每一次使用那把剑时一样。仿佛那是它的召唤。{w}\n然而，这道白光几乎刚出现就消退了。

column5: It seems to leave everybody in the arena blinded.{w}\nThey stagger back, waving their hands over their eyes, unable to see.{w}\nIn their confusion, they step back, revealing a gap in their formation.
column6: 它似乎让竞技场里的所有人都陷入了失明。{w}\n他们踉跄后退，双手在眼前挥舞，什么也看不见。{w}\n在一片混乱中，他们后退，露出了阵型中的一个缺口。

column5: And that gap is exactly where Vivien now stands.{w}\nWith my comrades also blinded, it might just be up to me.{w}\nI grip the blade, and watch Vivien panic in his sight-robbed state.
column6: 而那个缺口正是薇薇安此刻站立的位置。{w}\n我的战友们也同样失明，或许只能靠我了。{w}\n我握紧剑刃，看着薇薇安在失去视线的状态下惊慌失措。

column5: And that gap is exactly where Draycu now stands.\nWith my comrades also blinded, it might just be up to me.{w}\nI grip the blade, and watch Draycu panic in his sight-robbed state.
column6: 而那个缺口正是德雷库此刻站立的位置。\n我的战友们也同样失明，或许只能靠我了。{w}\n我握紧剑刃，看着德雷库在失去视线的状态下惊慌失措。

column5: The crowd grows silent, almost in awe at what's going on.{w}\nAll eyes are on me. They know I used my blade to do this.{w}\nI gulp, unsure if I should attack, or wait for their sight to return.
column6: 人群渐渐安静下来，几乎对眼前发生的事感到敬畏。{w}\n所有的目光都集中在我身上。他们知道是我用剑做到了这一切。{w}\n我咽了口唾沫，不确定该进攻，还是等他们的视力恢复。

column5: I don't want them to think I'm a coward who needs to disarm their foes.{w}\nWith so many people watching, I need to consider what image I give off.{w}\nI would be in the highest seat of power after this war. I need to think.
column6: 我不想让他们觉得我是个必须靠让人失明才能取胜的懦夫。{w}\n这么多人看着，我得考虑自己给人留下什么形象。{w}\n这场战争之后我将坐上最高的权位。我得好好想想。

column5: I grab my blade, and guide my body to a battle-ready stance.{w}\nThis is it. I was about to decide the fate of Alarinthia.{w}\nIt would be over, without the death of my comrades.
column6: 我握紧剑刃，把身体摆成随时应战的姿势。{w}\n就是现在。我即将决定阿拉林西亚的命运。{w}\n一切都会结束，而不必让我的战友们死去。

column5: I prepare to charge, but then — everything changes.{w}\nI feel a grip on my shoulder, preventing me from moving.{w}\nTurning to face the source of the intrusion, I tremble in fright.
column6: 我准备冲锋，但就在这时——一切都变了。{w}\n我感觉到一只手抓住我的肩膀，让我动弹不得。{w}\n我转身面对这突如其来的打扰，恐惧得发抖。

column5: No, I couldn't rely on the blade to win this battle. It was cheating.{w}\nBreaking through this attack was enough to put us back on equal ground.{w}\nThat's all we needed to win. We wouldn't get caught off guard again.
column6: 不，我不能靠那把剑来赢下这场战斗。那是作弊。{w}\n冲破这次攻势，就足以让我们重回同一起跑线。{w}\n那便是我们获胜所需的全部。我们不会再被打个措手不及。

column5: I prepare to sheathe my blade, but then — everything changes.{w}\nI feel a grip on my shoulder, preventing me from moving at all.{w}\nTurning to face the source of the intrusion, I tremble in fright.
column6: 我准备收回剑刃，但就在这时——一切都变了。{w}\n我感觉到一只手抓住我的肩膀，让我完全动弹不得。{w}\n我转身面对这突如其来的打扰，恐惧得发抖。

column5: It was Ulric.
column6: 是乌尔里克。

column5: Sorry. I can't have you getting in the way.\nI have to do this, [firstname]. Please forgive me.
column6: 抱歉。我不能让你碍事。\n我必须这么做，[firstname]。请原谅我。

column5: The grip on my shoulder tightens, into something more crushing.{w}\nHis aggression is clear, and for the first time, I'm frightened by him.{w}\nHe holds up his blade, and re-positions his hand, to use the base as a weapon.
column6: 抓住我肩膀的手收紧了，变得更像是一种碾压。{w}\n他的敌意显而易见，我第一次对他感到恐惧。{w}\n他举起剑刃，调整握法，要将剑柄当作武器。

column5: And he smashes it against my face repeatedly.
column6: 然后他一次次地把剑柄砸向我的脸。

column5: I scream and fall to my knees. Blood pours from my nose.{w}\nMy vision gets hazy, and soon, I fall to the ground completely.{w}\nLooking at the gap in the enemy forces, I see Pro step through.
column6: 我尖叫着跪倒在地。血从鼻子里涌出。{w}\n我的视线变得模糊，很快，我彻底倒在了地上。{w}\n望向敌军阵型中的缺口，我看见普洛从中走出。

column5: He holds a dagger out at Ulric, who holds out his blade in turn.{w}\nThe light still blinds most of the other fighters, making this a one-on-one battle.{w}\nI reach out and try to stop them, but it's no use. They immediately charge at one another.
column6: 他用匕首指着乌尔里克，乌尔里克也举起了剑刃。{w}\n那道光仍让大多数其他战斗者失明，使这场战斗变成了一对一。{w}\n我伸手想阻止他们，但毫无用处。他们立刻朝彼此冲了过去。

column5: Pain radiates through my entire body, and I'm almost unable to focus.{w}\nTheir weapons clash, again and again, and I finally see Pro fight.{w}\nHe dodges with grace, almost like watching the moves of a dancer.
column6: 疼痛传遍我全身，我几乎无法集中精神。{w}\n他们的武器一次次碰撞，我终于看到普洛战斗的样子。{w}\n他优雅地闪避，几乎像在欣赏一名舞者的动作。

column5: Give it up, Pro!\nThis is what I was {i}meant{/i} to do.\nChanging Alarinthia means everything to me.
column6: 放弃吧，普洛！\n这才是我{i}注定{/i}要做的事。\n改变阿拉林西亚对我来说意味着一切。

column5: I can't let you win, Ulric!\nWe need Draycu's strength to take down The Triumvirate.\nYou can always come back and change things {i}after{/i} the war...!
column6: 我不能让你赢，乌尔里克！\n我们需要德雷库的力量来击败三人执政团。\n你大可以等战争{i}结束{/i}之后再回来改变一切……！

column5: Never...!
column6: 绝不……！

column5: They continue to fight, ignoring each other's pleas.{w}\nBut they'd have to do something quick. The other soldiers are shaking things off.{w}\nI keep trying to crawl toward them. Their battle was with Vivien and Draycu, not each other!
column6: 他们继续厮杀，无视彼此的恳求。{w}\n但他们得赶快做点什么。其他士兵正在缓过神来。{w}\n我一直试图朝他们爬去。他们的对手是薇薇安和德雷库，不是彼此！

column5: Are you really willing to die for this...?\nThink about what Draycu can help us accomplish!
column6: 你真的愿意为此去死吗……？\n想想德雷库能帮我们成就什么！

column5: If the choice is between fighting alongside Draycu, and death...?\nThen yeah, I'm willing to die for this, Pro. But I have to ask.\nAre you willing to kill me in the name of my enemy?
column6: 如果选择是在与德雷库并肩作战和死亡之间……？\n那么是的，我愿意为此去死，普洛。但我得问一句。\n你愿意以我敌人的名义杀了我吗？

column5: Y-yes, of course...!
column6: 是、是的，当然……！

column5: He looks nervous, like Ulric is calling out a bluff.{w}\nHe takes slow, intimidating steps toward Pro.{w}\nIn response, Pro starts to panic and step back.
column6: 他看起来很紧张，仿佛乌尔里克戳穿了一个虚张声势的谎言。{w}\n他缓慢而威压地朝普洛迈步。{w}\n作为回应，普洛开始惊慌，向后退去。

column5: If you're willing to kill me, then do it!\nShow me that our friendship means {i}nothing{/i} to you!
column6: 如果你愿意杀了我，那就动手啊！\n让我看看我们的情谊对你来说{i}一文不值{/i}！

column5: But we're family...
column6: 可我们是家人啊……

column5: It looks like Pro is about to cry.
column6: 普洛看起来快要哭了。

column5: No, that's just an excuse {i}you{/i} made up.
column6: 不，那只是{i}你{/i}编出来的借口。

column5: W-why are you saying this...?
column6: 你、你为什么说这种话……？

column5: Because I don't believe you're willing to kill me.\nBut I stand here, ready to kill {i}you{/i} at a moment's notice.\nThat need for friends and family, to be loved — that's your weakness.
column6: 因为我不信你下得了手杀我。\n而我站在这里，随时准备好杀了{i}你{/i}。\n对朋友和家人的那份渴求，那份被爱的渴望——那就是你的弱点。

column5: All I've ever wanted was to change this nation for the better.\nYou, Damek, [firstname]... You're worth less than pawns to me.\nSo I'll give you {i}one{/i} chance to kill me. Take my life, or lose {i}yours{/i}.
column6: 我想要的从来只有让这个国家变得更好。\n你、达梅克、[firstname]……你们对我还不如棋子有价值。\n所以我给你{i}一次{/i}杀我的机会。取走我的命，或者丢掉{i}你的{/i}。

column5: Ulric, stop...!
column6: 乌尔里克，住手……！

column5: In response, Ulric readies his blade, and steps closer to Pro.{w}\nThere's nothing I can do anymore. I'm practically choking on my own blood.{w}\nAny weak cries I emit would be easily overtaken by the chatter of our audience.
column6: 作为回应，乌尔里克举起兵刃，朝普洛逼近。{w}\n我已经无能为力了。我几乎被自己的血呛住。{w}\n我发出的任何微弱呼喊，都会被观众的喧哗轻易盖过。

column5: A chatter that soon turns into roaring applause.
column6: 那喧哗很快就变成了震耳欲聋的掌声。

column5: Pro steps forward, and plunges his dagger into Ulric's gut.{w}\nA look of horror appears on his face as he does so. But he doesn't stop.{w}\nMuch like Shane did to Damek, Pro attacks Ulric, intending to kill.
column6: 普洛上前一步，把匕首刺进乌尔里克的腹部。{w}\n他这样做时，脸上浮现出惊恐的神情。但他没有停下。{w}\n就像肖恩对达梅克所做的那样，普洛攻击乌尔里克，意图取他性命。

column5: The look of shock on Ulric's face is painful to look at.{w}\nHe was so certain that Pro lacked the resolve to harm him.{w}\nThat bet ended against his favor, and he slowly falls to the ground.
column6: 乌尔里克脸上震惊的表情让人不忍直视。{w}\n他那么确信普洛没有伤害他的决心。{w}\n那场赌局他输了，他缓缓倒在地上。

column5: Ulric — I'm sorry...
column6: 乌尔里克——对不起……

column5: Pro lunges forward to attack Ulric, but he quickly counters.{w}\nGripping Pro's arm, he quickly seizes the dagger for himself.
column6: 普洛扑上前去攻击乌尔里克，但他迅速反击。{w}\n他抓住普洛的手臂，迅速夺过匕首据为己有。

column5: So that's the way it is, huh...?\nYou're a fool, Pro. Always were.
column6: 原来是这样啊……？\n你是个蠢货，普洛。一直都是。

column5: Throwing his own greatsword on the ground, he stares in Pro's eyes.{w}\nPro trembles in fear, realizing he played right into Ulric's hand.{w}\nHe'd dodge Pro's erratic attack, rather than launching his own.
column6: 他把自己的巨剑扔在地上，直视普洛的眼睛。{w}\n普洛恐惧地发抖，意识到自己正好落入了乌尔里克的圈套。{w}\n他会闪避普洛凌乱的攻击，而不是主动出击。

column5: Ulric, let me go...!
column6: 乌尔里克，放开我……！

column5: As he holds Pro firmly in place, he closes his eyes.
column6: 他牢牢制住普洛，闭上了眼睛。

column5: I'm sorry it had to come to this.\nBut know that your death will create a better nation.\nAnd hopefully, that will lead us all to a better world.
column6: 很抱歉事情走到了这一步。\n但你要知道，你的死会缔造一个更好的国家。\n但愿那会引领我们所有人走向更好的世界。

column5: He plunges the dagger into Pro's gut multiple times.{w}\nThe look on their faces reminds me of Shane and Damek.{w}\nBut something tells me that Pro wouldn't be as lucky.
column6: 他一次次把匕首刺进普洛的腹部。{w}\n他们脸上的神情让我想起肖恩和达梅克。{w}\n但直觉告诉我，普洛不会有那样的好运。

column5: I can hear him cry and whimper as he falls to the ground.
column6: 他倒在地上时，我能听见他的哭喊和呜咽。

column5: Looks like you were finally good for {i}something{/i}.
column6: 看来你终于还有点{i}用处{/i}。

column5: That's the last thing I can remember.{w}\nSuccumbing to grief, and agony, I slowly pass out.{w}\nThe crowd goes wild, as the soldiers finally overcome their blindness.
column6: 这是我能记住的最后一件事。{w}\n在悲痛与剧痛中，我渐渐失去了意识。{w}\n士兵们终于摆脱了失明，人群疯狂起来。

column5: They're greeted to the sight of a victor, but I only see a man who lost.{w}\nAn empty victory, and one we would surely never fully recover from.{w}\nCrying at our loss, my vision fades, as I lie in a puddle of my own blood.
column6: 他们看到的是一位胜者，而我看到的只是一个失去了一切的人。{w}\n一场空洞的胜利，一场我们必将永远无法完全从中恢复的胜利。{w}\n为我们失去的一切哭泣着，我躺在自己的一滩血里，视线渐渐模糊。

column5: My eyes slowly open, and I find myself back in the coliseum private chambers.{w}\nPain radiates throughout my head, pulsing with my heartbeat. It's almost unbearable.{w}\nI notice some empty vials on the nightstand, and an odd taste in my mouth. Painkillers.
column6: 我缓缓睁开眼睛，发现自己回到了大竞技场的私人房间。{w}\n疼痛随着我的心跳阵阵传遍整个头部。几乎令人无法忍受。{w}\n我注意到床头柜上有些空药瓶，嘴里还有一股奇怪的味道。止痛药。

column5: Valessa and Fortaime sit on chairs beside the bed, watching me intently.
column6: 瓦莱莎和福泰姆坐在床边的椅子上，专注地看着我。

column5: He's waking up!
column6: 他醒了！

column5: She's waking up!
column6: 她醒了！

column5: Fortaime immediately rises from his chair, and runs over to me.{w}\nThe worry on his face is clear, but everybody breathes a sigh of relief.
column6: 福泰姆立刻从椅子上起身，跑到我身边。{w}\n他脸上的担忧显而易见，但所有人都松了一口气。

column5: That is, except for Ulric.{w}\nHe stands in the corner of the room, with his arms crossed.{w}\nAfter what he just did, I'm not surprised that he acts distant.
column6: 只有乌尔里克例外。{w}\n他抱着双臂站在房间的角落。{w}\n经历了刚才的事，他表现得疏离，我一点也不意外。

column5: That is, except for Pro.{w}\nHe stands in the corner of the room, with his arms crossed.{w}\nAfter what he just did, I'm not surprised that he acts somewhat distant.
column6: 只有普洛例外。{w}\n他抱着双臂站在房间的角落。{w}\n经历了刚才的事，他表现得有些疏离，我一点也不意外。

column5: We were so worried, [firstname]!\nWe didn't know if you'd recover. Ulric did some damage.\nYour nose is broken, but if you give it time, you'll be totally fine.
column6: 我们担心死了，[firstname]！\n我们不知道你还能不能恢复。乌尔里克下手不轻。\n你的鼻子断了，但只要给它时间，你会完全好起来的。

column5: Upon hearing this, Ulric rolls his eyes.{w}\nI can't believe it, but Pro was dead. Ulric killed him.\nOur alliance with Vivien was secured. But was it worth it...?
column6: 听到这话，乌尔里克翻了翻白眼。{w}\n我简直不敢相信，普洛死了。是乌尔里克杀了他。\n我们与薇薇安的同盟确立了。但这值得吗……？

column5: Upon hearing this, Pro rolls his eyes.\nI can't believe it, but Ulric was dead. Pro killed him.\nOur alliance with Draycu was secured. But was it worth it...?
column6: 听到这话，普洛翻了翻白眼。\n我简直不敢相信，乌尔里克死了。是普洛杀了他。\n我们与德雷库的同盟确立了。但这值得吗……？

column5: That's not a question I could possibly answer.{w}\nOn one hand, that sacrifice could ensure the safety of millions.{w}\nBut we were comrades. Bonds complicated things during a time of war.
column6: 这个问题我根本无法回答。{w}\n一方面，那次牺牲或许能确保数百万人的安全。{w}\n但我们是战友。在战争时期，羁绊会让事情变得复杂。

column5: And there was no time to grieve, either. We needed to prepare for Balteus.{w}\nI let my legs dangle off the bed, and find their place on the warm stone floor.{w}\nI can sense the denial in the air. Nobody wanted to talk about what just happened.
column6: 而且也没有时间哀悼。我们得为巴尔泰乌斯做准备。{w}\n我把双腿垂下床，让它们落在温暖的石地板上。{w}\n我能感觉到空气中弥漫的逃避。没人愿意谈起刚刚发生的事。

column5: So what's the next step...?
column6: 那下一步怎么办……？

column5: Damek enters the conversation.
column6: 达梅克加入了谈话。

column5: With our alliance finalized, we need to head back to Mazeo.\nAfter some swift preparation, we'll launch the assault on Balteus.\nThis is it. We've come away from this with more soldiers than ever.
column6: 同盟已定，我们得回马泽奥去。\n做些快速准备之后，我们就要对巴尔泰乌斯发动进攻。\n就是现在。经历过这一切，我们带回来的士兵比以往任何时候都多。

column5: Howl steps forward, and enters the conversation as well.
column6: 豪尔上前一步，也加入了谈话。

column5: The Triumvirate would not expect us to recover this quickly.\nBut here we stand, stronger than ever before. We can win this war.\nWe would advise not mulling over this sacrifice. It secured us victory.
column6: 三人执政团不会料到我们恢复得这么快。\n但我们站在这里，比以往任何时候都更强大。我们能赢下这场战争。\n我们建议不要为这次牺牲反复纠结。它为我们确保了胜利。

column5: Yeah. Ulric might not have sided with Draycu, but he sided with {i}us{/i}.\nWe're still going to secure the future he was fighting for. Alestia's future.\nHe was a dear friend, and this loss will give me more power — more resolve.
column6: 是啊。乌尔里克或许没有站在德雷库那边，但他站在了{i}我们{/i}这边。\n我们仍然会去实现他为之奋斗的未来。阿莱斯蒂亚的未来。\n他是我亲爱的朋友，这份失去会给我更多力量——更多决心。

column5: A good outlook. Wasting time to mourn could cost us this entire war.\nWe must make our way to the docks, and meet with Draycu.\nFocus on the things that are within our control, [firstname].
column6: 很好的心态。把时间浪费在哀悼上，可能会让我们输掉整场战争。\n我们必须前往码头，与德雷库会合。\n专注于我们能掌控的事情，[firstname]。

column5: Yeah. Pro may not have sided with Vivien, but he sided with {i}us{/i}.\nWe're still going to secure the future he was fighting for. Alestia's future.\nHe was a dear friend, and this loss will give me more power — more resolve.
column6: 是啊。普洛或许没有站在薇薇安那边，但他站在了{i}我们{/i}这边。\n我们仍然会去实现他为之奋斗的未来。阿莱斯蒂亚的未来。\n他是我亲爱的朋友，这份失去会给我更多力量——更多决心。

column5: A good outlook. Wasting time to mourn could cost us this entire war.\nWe must make our way to the docks, and meet with Vivien.\nFocus on the things that are within our control, [firstname].
column6: 很好的心态。把时间浪费在哀悼上，可能会让我们输掉整场战争。\n我们必须前往码头，与薇薇安会合。\n专注于我们能掌控的事情，[firstname]。

column5: I nod. A suggestion born from denial, no doubt.{w}\nHowever, despite its origins, it was a good idea.{w}\nWe still have business to take care of, no matter what.
column6: 我点了点头。这建议无疑源自逃避。{w}\n然而，尽管它来路如此，这也是个好主意。{w}\n无论如何，我们还有正事要处理。

column5: I stand up, getting out of the bed, and everyone looks worried.{w}\nThey brace themselves to catch me, in case I were to fall over.{w}\nI stumble slightly, but I'm fine. I think I was ready to get things moving.
column6: 我起身下床，所有人都露出担忧的神情。{w}\n他们绷紧身体准备扶住我，以防我跌倒。{w}\n我微微踉跄了一下，但没事。我想我已经准备好推动事情往前走了。

column5: So, should we just start walking to the docks?\nLet's make sure to stock up on lots of water.\nThe journey back isn't going to be any easier.
column6: 那么，我们是不是该动身去码头了？\n一定要带足大量的水。\n回去的旅程不会轻松多少。

column5: He gets ready to leave, but Fortaime interjects.
column6: 他准备离开，但福泰姆插了话。

column5: Whoa, hold on a second here.\nBefore we go, I have a question to ask.
column6: 等等，先别急着走。\n走之前，我有个问题要问。

column5: Pro, why did you do this...?\nYou could've waited, and went after Vivien!
column6: 普洛，你为什么要这么做……？\n你本可以再等等，去对付薇薇安的！

column5: Everyone looks shocked, but I know it's something we're all thinking.{w}\nWithout a single word, Pro shakes his head, and walks out of the room.
column6: 所有人都显得震惊，但我知道这是大家心里都在想的。{w}\n普洛一言不发，摇了摇头，走出了房间。

column5: Hey, I asked you a question, you coward!
column6: 喂，我问你话呢，你这个懦夫！

column5: He looks over at Ulric, who exchanges an awkward glance.
column6: 他看向乌尔里克，后者与他交换了一个尴尬的眼神。

column5: Ulric, why did you do this?\nYou could've waited, and went after Draycu!
column6: 乌尔里克，你为什么要这么做？\n你本可以再等等，去对付德雷库的！

column5: Everyone looks shocked, but I know it's something we're all thinking.{w}\nWithout a single word, Ulric shakes his head, and walks out of the room.
column6: 所有人都显得震惊，但我知道这是大家心里都在想的。{w}\n乌尔里克一言不发，摇了摇头，走出了房间。

column5: Hey, I asked you a question, you coward...!
column6: 喂，我问你话呢，你这个懦夫……！

column5: It's no use. He's already long gone.{w}\nLikely to the docks, as I know he wouldn't abandon us.{w}\nAs bad as his actions were, he still seems to serve our cause.
column6: 没用。他早就走远了。{w}\n大概是去码头了，因为我知道他不会抛下我们。{w}\n无论他的行为有多糟，他似乎仍在为我们的目标出力。

column5: Fortaime...
column6: 福泰姆……

column5: I know we have an alliance or whatever, but who cares!?\nWe lost one of our friends. Why is nobody even sad...?
column6: 我知道我们有什么同盟之类的，但那又怎样！？\n我们失去了一个朋友。为什么连一个伤心的人都没有……？

column5: We'll have plenty of time to grieve after this war is over.\nWe've lost plenty, and I'm sure we'll be losing even more.\nBut if we give up and mope around? We'll lose {i}everything{/i}.
column6: 这场战争结束后，我们有的是时间哀悼。\n我们已经失去了很多，我相信我们还会失去更多。\n但如果我们就此放弃、垂头丧气？我们就会失去{i}一切{/i}。

column5: We're not forgetting about him, Fortaime.\nWe just have more important things to focus on.\nLet's get to the docks. We can talk more on the trip home.
column6: 我们没有忘记他，福泰姆。\n只是我们有更重要的事要专注。\n去码头吧。回程的路上我们可以多聊聊。

column5: That's part of the problem Valessa. I don't even know what home {i}is{/i} anymore.\nIt was Valinorth, and then Mazeo. But everything around us is getting destroyed!\nThen I thought home was being with our friends. But now {i}they're{/i} dying, Valessa...
column6: 这正是问题的一部分，瓦莱莎。我甚至不知道家{i}是{/i}什么了。\n它曾是瓦利诺斯，然后是马泽奥。可我们周围的一切都在被摧毁！\n后来我以为家就是和朋友们在一起。但如今{i}他们{/i}也在死去，瓦莱莎……

column5: Nobody knows how to respond to Fortaime's words.{w}\nAn awkward silence fills the room, but he gets the idea.
column6: 没人知道该如何回应福泰姆的话。{w}\n房间里充满尴尬的沉默，但他明白了。

column5: Fine. Forget I even said anything.\nBut we were betrayed, plain and simple, by one of our own.\nIt may have gotten us an alliance, but it's still a betrayal.
column6: 算了。就当我什么都没说过。\n但我们被背叛了，就这么简单，被我们自己人背叛了。\n它或许为我们换来了一个同盟，但这终究是背叛。

column5: And in my books, people like that deserve to be punished.\nSo you can push this aside, or whatever, but I {i}won't{/i}.\nThis is a crime that needs to be answered for.
column6: 而在我看来，这种人活该受到惩罚。\n所以你们大可以把这事抛到一边，随便怎样，但我{i}不会{/i}。\n这是必须被清算的罪行。

column5: After saying that, he storms out of the room.{w}\nI suppose he was right, but it's really not that simple.{w}\nThere's no point in arguing, however, so we all start to leave.
column6: 说完，他怒气冲冲地走出了房间。{w}\n我想他是对的，但事情真的没那么简单。{w}\n不过争论也没意义，于是我们都开始往外走。

column5: Well, I guess maybe venting like that could help.\nLet's just get it out of the way while we're walking, alright?\nEvery moment we waste, makes our enemy more prepared.
column6: 嗯，我想那样发泄一下也许会有帮助。\n我们就边走边把话说开，好吗？\n我们浪费的每一刻，都会让敌人准备得更充分。

column5: Everybody seems to agree, and we all shuffle out of the room.{w}\nAnd so begins the long and arduous journey back to the docks.{w}\nHowever, instead of hope, this trek would be filled with a feeling of despair.
column6: 大家似乎都同意了，我们拖着步子走出房间。{w}\n就这样，返回码头的漫长而艰辛的旅程开始了。{w}\n然而，这段旅程没有希望，只有绝望的气息。

column5: Our entire party remains in silence, until we arrive at the oasis.{w}\nHaving gone through all of our water, we needed to fill up immediately.{w}\nWe're all sweating, clearly exerted by our journey through the desert.
column6: 我们整支队伍一路沉默，直到抵达绿洲。{w}\n水都用完了，我们必须立刻补充。{w}\n我们个个汗流浃背，显然被穿越沙漠的旅途耗尽了力气。

column5: Well, it's time for a brief break.\nLet's get some water, and then head to the docks.\nIf I remember correctly, this means we're halfway there.
column6: 嗯，该短暂休息一下了。\n弄点水喝，然后继续去码头。\n要是我没记错，这意味着我们走了一半了。

column5: We all nod, and start filling up our canteens with water.{w}\nBut while I do, I pay attention to what's going on around me.
column6: 我们都点了点头，开始往水壶里灌水。{w}\n但我一边灌，一边留意着周围的动静。

column5: Pro makes sure he's standing beside Fortaime while he fills up on water.{w}\nFortaime notices this, and seems visibly angry. It's totally understandable, though.
column6: 普洛灌水时特意站到了福泰姆身边。{w}\n福泰姆注意到这一点，显然很生气。不过完全可以理解。

column5: What do you want...?
column6: 你想干什么……？

column5: Look, I just wanted to say that I'm sorry.\nYou'll understand one day. I promise.
column6: 听着，我只是想说声对不起。\n总有一天你会明白的。我保证。

column5: Trust me, I can tell that you're {i}not{/i} sorry.\nThere was no remorse on your face when you killed him.\nAnd even now, I see no hint of sadness on your face. Forget it.
column6: 相信我，我看得出你{i}根本{/i}不觉得抱歉。\n你杀他时脸上没有一丝悔意。\n就算现在，我也在你脸上看不到半点悲伤。算了吧。

column5: I'm serious, Fortaime!
column6: 我是认真的，福泰姆！

column5: So am I...!\nJust leave me alone, Pro.\nWe'd be better off without you.
column6: 我也是……！\n别烦我了，普洛。\n没有你我们会过得更好。

column5: These words seem to hit Pro like a knife to the heart.{w}\nHis eyes water up, and I can tell that he's on the verge of tears.
column6: 这些话仿佛一把刀插进普洛的心脏。{w}\n他眼眶湿润，我看得出他快要哭出来了。

column5: Fine. You win.\nBut don't say I didn't try.
column6: 好。你赢了。\n但别说我没试过。

column5: Ulric makes sure he's standing beside Fortaime while he fills up on water.{w}\nFortaime notices this, and seems visibly angry. It's totally understandable, though.
column6: 乌尔里克灌水时特意站到了福泰姆身边。{w}\n福泰姆注意到这一点，显然很生气。不过完全可以理解。

column5: What do you want...?
column6: 你想干什么……？

column5: I just wanted to apologize, Fortaime.\nYou'll understand soon. I had no other choice.
column6: 我只是想道个歉，福泰姆。\n你很快就会明白的。我别无选择。

column5: There's no way you're sorry, Ulric.\nI saw no hint of remorse on your face when you killed him.\nAnd even now that you're apologizing, you don't look sad at all!
column6: 你绝不可能觉得抱歉，乌尔里克。\n你杀他时，我在你脸上看不到一丝悔意。\n就算现在你在道歉，你也一点也不显得难过！

column5: That's not true.\nI'm being serious, here.
column6: 不是那样的。\n我是认真的。

column5: Well so am I...!\nJust leave me alone, Ulric.\nWe'd all be better off without you.
column6: 我也是……！\n别烦我了，乌尔里克。\n没有你我们大家都会过得更好。

column5: Ulric takes a step back, hurt by Fortaime's words.{w}\nIf he wasn't sad before, then he definitely is now.
column6: 乌尔里克后退一步，被福泰姆的话刺伤了。{w}\n如果他之前不难过，那么现在他肯定难过了。

column5: Fine.
column6: 好吧。

column5: He walks away from Fortaime, considering the conversation over.{w}\nAs harsh as Fortaime was, I think he's saying what's on a lot of our minds.{w}\nAlmost everybody has been treating him with disdain since the battle ended.
column6: 他离开福泰姆，认为谈话已经结束。{w}\n无论福泰姆说得多么刺耳，我觉得他说出了很多人心里的话。{w}\n战斗结束以来，几乎所有人都对他报以蔑视。

column5: After we're all done gathering water, Fortaime approaches me.{w}\nHe looks so conflicted. After all, he's the only one being vocal about this situation.{w}\nEspecially after his outburst just now. He's starting to wonder if he's being too emotional.
column6: 我们打完水之后，福泰姆走过来找我。{w}\n他看起来十分纠结。毕竟，他是唯一一个对这事直言不讳的人。{w}\n尤其是刚才发泄过之后。他开始怀疑自己是不是太情绪化了。

column5: Come on, [firstname].\nYou have my back in this, right?\nWhat happened was {i}way{/i} out of line.
column6: 说句话啊，[firstname]。\n在这件事上你站在我这边，对吧？\n发生的事{i}实在{/i}太过分了。

column5: I know that everybody is focusing on the war right now.\nBut I can't do that. This is just too much to take in.\nWhat should I do? Are you going to forgive this...?
column6: 我知道现在每个人都在专注于战争。\n但我做不到。这实在让人难以接受。\n我该怎么办？你会原谅这种事吗……？

column5: Do they really, though?\nIf The Triumvirate asked for a second chance, you'd give them one?\nI don't think that's true. It's just harder because we're all friends.
column6: 真的会吗？\n如果三人执政团请求再给一次机会，你会给吗？\n我不那么认为。只是因为我们都是朋友，所以才更难办。

column5: But then why should friends get a free pass to commit atrocities...?\nThis whole thing is just so messed up. It doesn't make any sense.\nHe should be punished, just like any other criminal, shouldn't he?
column6: 可那样的话，朋友凭什么就能免于为暴行负责……？\n这整件事都太扭曲了。根本说不通。\n他应该受到惩罚，就像任何其他罪犯一样，不是吗？

column5: Good. Then that means we're on the same page.\nIt's just so hard because of how close we are.
column6: 好。那说明我们想法一致。\n只是因为我们关系如此亲近，所以才这么难。

column5: But why should a friend get a free pass to commit murder?\nEveryone else seems so lenient. Are they just going to forgive this?\nHe should be punished, just like any other criminal, shouldn't he?
column6: 但朋友凭什么就能免于为谋杀负责？\n其他人似乎都太宽容了。他们就要这样原谅这件事吗？\n他应该受到惩罚，就像任何其他罪犯一样，不是吗？

column5: Maybe I'm just processing this faster than anybody else.\nI know it's hard, because of how close we all are.\nBut a crime is a crime. Plain and simple.
column6: 也许只是我比其他人消化的速度快一些。\n我知道这很难，因为我们关系那么亲近。\n但罪行就是罪行。就这么简单。

column5: Friends shouldn't get a free pass to commit atrocities.\nI don't care if other people forgive him. I never could.\nHe needs to be punished. Like any other criminal.
column6: 朋友不该免于为暴行负责。\n我不在乎别人是否原谅他。我永远都做不到。\n他必须受到惩罚。就像任何其他罪犯一样。

column5: I shrug, unsure of how to respond to that last part.{w}\nHe did kill a comrade, but it secured us a powerful alliance.{w}\nWe have to wonder if such actions cancel each other out.
column6: 我耸了耸肩，不知该如何回应最后那部分。{w}\n他确实杀了一个战友，但这为我们确保了一个强大的同盟。{w}\n我们不得不去想，这样的行为是否能相互抵消。

column5: One life gave us all the power we'd need to win this war.{w}\nBut at the same time, is it right to reduce a life to something like that?{w}\nA bargaining chip on some sort of table containing all of our lives?
column6: 一条命给了我们赢得这场战争所需的全部力量。{w}\n但与此同时，把一条生命简化成这样的东西，对吗？{w}\n像是一个摆在砧板上、与我们所有人性命一起被押上的筹码？

column5: This is something we'd have to talk about as an entire group.{w}\nI may be in charge, but this affected everybody — not just me.{w}\nThat's what I let Fortaime know. It's the only right way to handle this.
column6: 这件事得由我们整个团队一起来谈。{w}\n我或许是负责人，但这件事影响的是所有人——不只是我。{w}\n这就是我让福泰姆明白的。这是处理此事的唯一正确方式。

column5: Alright. But just take my advice.\nDon't do it while everybody is still in shock.\nLet them process these events, and form an opinion.
column6: 好吧。但听我一句劝。\n别在大家还震惊的时候谈。\n让他们消化这些事，形成自己的想法。

column5: I nod, and it seems like we're all ready to continue.{w}\nSince we're halfway to the docks, we'd have a long time to think.{w}\nBut something tells me no time in the world would let us sort this out.
column6: 我点了点头，看来我们都准备好继续赶路了。{w}\n既然我们离码头还有一半路程，会有很长时间去思考。{w}\n但直觉告诉我，无论多久，都无法让我们理清这件事。

column5: My head throbs, as the painkillers started to wear off around the oasis.{w}\nMy coherence fades in and out, though my body still moves. I'm barely conscious.{w}\nBefore I know it, we're already back at the docks. However, I didn't miss anything of note.
column6: 头痛阵阵袭来，止痛药在绿洲附近就开始失效了。{w}\n我的意识时断时续，尽管身体还在移动。我几乎失去了知觉。{w}\n等我回过神来，我们已经回到了码头。不过，我没漏掉任何重要的事。

column5: What surely took a portion of the entire day, seemed like mere moments to me.{w}\nOur group scatters out, but not too far. We're all within earshot of each other.{w}\nI notice our new ally is waiting by the ship. Damek quickly approaches him.
column6: 那肯定花了将近一天中的大半天，对我来说却仿佛只是片刻。{w}\n我们这群人散开了，但没走远。大家都互相能听见。{w}\n我注意到我们的新盟友在船边等着。达梅克迅速朝他走去。

column5: Draycu, there you are!\nHappy that you're still in power, I assume?
column6: 德雷库，你在这儿！\n我猜，你还掌权着，挺高兴的吧？

column5: It went exactly as expected.\nWe're ready to aid your attack on Balteus.\nI'll personally lead my army in the name of your Monarch.
column6: 一切都如预期。\n我们已准备好协助你们进攻巴尔泰乌斯。\n我会以你们君主的名义，亲自率领我的军队。

column5: Wait, you're leaving Alarinthia...?\nWill everything be fine in your absence?
column6: 等等，你要离开阿拉林西亚……？\n你不在，一切都没问题吗？

column5: Yeah, it'll be fine. I wouldn't worry about it.\nVivien's defeat has made him hide his face in shame.\nI don't think anybody else will challenge the throne anytime soon.
column6: 嗯，会没事的。我不担心。\n薇薇安战败后羞愧得躲了起来。\n我想短期内不会再有人挑战王位了。

column5: At least, not in the next couple days.\nThe attack {i}is{/i} happening soon, isn't it?
column6: 至少接下来几天不会。\n进攻{i}很快{/i}就要开始，不是吗？

column5: Yeah. Within a day or two.\nAfter we get back to Mazeo, we need to wrap things up.\nWhen we set sail to Balteus, we might not be returning.
column6: 是啊。一两天之内。\n回到马泽奥之后，我们得把事情收尾。\n等我们启航前往巴尔泰乌斯，也许就回不来了。

column5: Have a little optimism, Damek.\nIf anybody can slay a team of Gods, it's us.
column6: 乐观一点，达梅克。\n要说有谁能杀死一队神明，那就是我们。

column5: Vivien, there you are!\nHow does it feel to be the one in power?
column6: 薇薇安，你在这儿！\n掌权的滋味如何？

column5: It's hard to believe, actually.\nI expect that it'll set in after the upcoming battle.\nI'm a man of my word, so I need to help you out first.
column6: 老实说，还很难相信。\n我想等接下来的战斗结束后才会真切起来。\n我是个言出必行的人，所以我得先帮你们。

column5: Wait — don't tell me you're coming with us?\nDon't you have things to take care of over here?
column6: 等等——别告诉我你要跟我们一起去？\n你这里没有事情要处理吗？

column5: It's nothing that can't wait a few days.\nThe attack is happening pretty soon, right?\nI can leave things in the hands of a few friends for now.
column6: 都是些可以等几天的事。\n进攻很快就要开始了，对吧？\n眼下我可以把事情交给几个朋友打理。

column5: Fair enough; and yeah, you're right.\nWe plan to launch the attack within a day or two.\nOnce we get to Mazeo, we need to take care of business.
column6: 有道理；是啊，你说得对。\n我们计划一两天内发动进攻。\n一到马泽奥，我们就得处理正事。

column5: I mean, final goodbyes, and stuff like that.\nAfter we leave for Balteus, we might never return.\nWe need to make sure that we leave with no regrets.
column6: 我是说，最后的告别之类的。\n我们前往巴尔泰乌斯之后，也许就再也回不来了。\n我们必须确保离开时没有遗憾。

column5: Have a little faith, Damek.\nIf anybody can take down those Gods — it's us.\nWe just overthrew an entire nation, I think that's a good sign.
column6: 有点信心，达梅克。\n要说有谁能扳倒那些神明——那就是我们。\n我们刚刚推翻了一整个国家，我觉得这是个好兆头。

column5: At that moment, we're interrupted by the last person I ever thought I'd see.
column6: 就在那时，我们被一个我做梦都没想到会见到的人打断了。

column5: Gods? Don't make me laugh.\nYou know just as well as I do that they're weak like us.\nThe true power rests with the one who can wield that blade.
column6: 神明？别逗我笑了。\n你和我一样清楚，他们和我们一样弱小。\n真正的力量属于那个能驾驭那把剑的人。

column5: We all stop what we're doing, and look toward the source of the noise.
column6: 我们都停下了手上的事，朝声音的来源望去。

column5: Terribly sorry to intrude, but I need to have a word with [firstname].\nIf you'd be so kind as to give us some privacy, I'd be forever grateful.
column6: 非常抱歉打扰，但我需要和[firstname]谈一谈。\n如果你们行个方便，给我们一点私人空间，我将感激不尽。

column5: It's Sovy...!{w} \nI immediately assume a battle stance.{w}\nFright quickly overtakes the air. This was bad...!
column6: 是索维……！{w}\n我立刻摆出战斗姿态。{w}\n恐惧迅速弥漫开来。这可不妙……！

column5: I'm not sure who remembers him from the Rebel HQ.{w}\nAnd I'm not sure if all of my comrades have seen him before.{w}\nBut they heed my warning, and assume stances similar to mine.
column6: 我不确定谁还记得反抗军总部里的他。{w}\n也不确定我的战友们是否都见过他。{w}\n但他们听从了我的警示，摆出了与我相似的姿态。

column5: A hostile greeting. I don't blame you.\nYou're only treating me the way I treated you.
column6: 充满敌意的问候。我不怪你们。\n你们不过是用我对待你们的方式对待我罢了。

column5: He takes a few steps forward, and I do so as well.{w}\nI notice that he looks at Damek. A man that he thought was dead.{w}\nA hint of emotion shows on his otherwise cold face as he does this.
column6: 他向前走了几步，我也一样。{w}\n我注意到他看向达梅克。一个他以为已经死了的人。{w}\n就在那时，他向来冰冷的脸上浮现出一丝情绪。

column5: So after this hostility, I expect mercy.\nRemember — if it weren't for me, you'd be dead.
column6: 那么在承受了这番敌意之后，我期待得到宽恕。\n记住——要不是我，你们早就死了。

column5: He immediately gets on his knees and holds out his wrists.
column6: 他立刻跪了下来，伸出双腕。

column5: I submit to your authority. \nRestrain me any way you wish — I only want to talk.\nWhen you get back to Mazeo, we can go our separate ways.
column6: 我服从你们的权威。\n你们想怎么捆我都行——我只想谈谈。\n等你们回到马泽奥，我们就各走各的。

column5: I'm shocked by his actions. I expected another fight to ensue.{w}\nI look around at my comrades, unsure of what to do in this situation.{w}\nIt was clearly a trap, right? What business would he have with us...?
column6: 他的举动让我震惊。我本以为又会打起来。{w}\n我环顾我的战友们，不知这种情况该如何是好。{w}\n这显然是陷阱，对吧？他找我们能有什么事……？

column5: Draycu. Restrain this man immediately.\nTake him to the brig, and make sure he can't escape.\nDo it before he tries to start anything. He's unarmed.
column6: 德雷库。立刻把这个人控制起来。\n把他押到禁闭室，确保他逃不掉。\n在他搞出什么名堂之前就动手。他没带武器。

column5: Draycu does as instructed, as Pro takes matters into his own hands.{w}\nHe's been doing that a lot lately. Acting without any of our input.{w}\nBut it's probably for the best. Sovy is alone, and seems harmless.
column6: 德雷库照办了，普洛自己拿起了主意。{w}\n他最近屡屡如此。不问我们的意见就行动。{w}\n但这大概是最好的做法。索维孤身一人，看起来毫无威胁。

column5: Last time he only did damage because of The Honor Guard.{w}\nThat, along with his Apprentice and Shane, was all he needed.{w}\nRight now, he had none of that. For once, he seemed vulnerable.
column6: 上次他能造成破坏，全靠荣誉卫队。{w}\n有荣誉卫队，再加上他的学徒和肖恩，就是他所需的全部。{w}\n而现在，这些他一样都没有。头一次，他显得脆弱。

column5: Vivien. Restrain this man immediately.\nTake him to the brig, and make sure he can't escape.\nHe's unarmed, and alone — so do it before he starts anything.
column6: 薇薇安。立刻把这个人控制起来。\n把他押到禁闭室，确保他逃不掉。\n他没带武器，还孤身一人——趁他还没搞出什么名堂就动手。

column5: Vivien does as instructed, as Ulric takes matters into his own hands.{w}\nIt was probably for the best. He seemed to know Sovy better than any of us.{w}\nSovy had no allies present, and no Honor Guard soldiers. Right now, he was weak.
column6: 薇薇安照办了，乌尔里克自己拿起了主意。{w}\n这大概是最好的做法。他似乎比我们任何人都更了解索维。{w}\n索维身边没有盟友，也没有荣誉卫队的士兵。此时此刻，他很虚弱。

column5: Once we set sail, come and talk to me, [firstname].\nI have some information that you might want to hear.\nIncluding the true identity of the mole among your forces.
column6: 等我们启航之后，来找我谈谈，[firstname]。\n我有一些你或许想听的消息。\n其中还包括你们队伍里那个内奸的真实身份。

column5: He's dragged away with what I interpret as a sinister smirk.{w}\nIt's likely that he couldn't be trusted. That's obvious psychological warfare.{w}\nTurn us against our own friends and we destroy each other from the inside.
column6: 他被拖走了，脸上挂着我理解为阴险的笑容。{w}\n他很可能不可信。这是显而易见的心理战。{w}\n让我们敌视自己的朋友，我们就会从内部自相残杀。

column5: An obvious attempt to sabotage our impending attack on Balteus.{w}\nBut, if we restrained him, and kept watch on him, we had a valuable asset.{w}\nThe Triumvirate's own Grand Inquisitor. That would make a {i}fine{/i} bargaining chip.
column6: 显然是企图破坏我们即将对巴尔泰乌斯发动的进攻。{w}\n但如果我们控制住他，时刻盯着他，我们就握有一件宝贵的资产。{w}\n三人执政团自己的大审判官。那可是一个{i}绝佳{/i}的筹码。

column5: Sorry about that, but we need to get things moving.\nIf we stay here any longer, we might get found out.\nAnd Sovy {i}definitely{/i} can't hear what I need to say.
column6: 抱歉，但我们得动身了。\n如果我们在这里再待下去，可能会被发现。\n而且索维{i}绝对{/i}不能听到我要说的话。

column5: Found out...? What does he mean?{w}\nHe looks around, worried, which confuses me.
column6: 被发现……？他是什么意思？{w}\n他担忧地环顾四周，让我更加困惑。

column5: Everybody, come here.\nI've been keeping a secret from all of you.\nWell, not just me — but hold on, you'll see.
column6: 大家，过来。\n我一直对你们所有人瞒着一个秘密。\n嗯，不只是我——但别急，你们会明白的。

column5: We look around, clueless as to what he's talking about.{w}\nBut following his instruction, we all gather around him.{w}\nHe tilts his head to the side, looking behind one of the nearby trees.
column6: 我们面面相觑，完全不明白他在说什么。{w}\n但我们照他的话做，都围到了他身边。{w}\n他把头偏向一侧，望向附近的一棵树后面。

column5: Sorry about that, but we need to get out of here, and fast.\nIf we stay in Alarinthia any longer, they might figure us out.\nAnd Sovy {i}definitely{/i} can't hear what I'm about to tell you.
column6: 抱歉，但我们得离开这里，而且要快。\n如果我们在阿拉林西亚再待下去，他们可能会看穿我们。\n而且索维{i}绝对{/i}不能听到我即将告诉你们的事。

column5: Figure us out...? What does he mean?{w}\nThere's worry, and paranoia on Ulric's face.
column6: 看穿我们……？他是什么意思？{w}\n乌尔里克脸上带着担忧和偏执。

column5: Come closer everybody.\nI'm afraid that I've been keeping a secret from all of you.\nBut it's not just me. Hold on a second, you'll see what I mean.
column6: 大家靠近点。\n恐怕我一直对你们所有人瞒着一个秘密。\n但不只是我。等一下，你们就明白我的意思了。

column5: We look around, clueless as to what he's talking about.{w}\nBut following his instruction, we all inch our way toward him.{w}\nHe tilts his head to the side, looking behind one of the nearby trees.
column6: 我们面面相觑，完全不明白他在说什么。{w}\n但我们照他的话做，都一点点朝他挪近。{w}\n他把头偏向一侧，望向附近的一棵树后面。

column5: And what happens next, leaves all of us speechless, in utter shock.
column6: 而接下来发生的事，让我们所有人都目瞪口呆，震惊得说不出话。

column5: Hey, you can come out now...
column6: 嘿，你可以出来了……

column5: And then, from behind a group of trees, steps out a man.{w}\nThey have a cloak covering their body, which they slowly drop to the ground.
column6: 接着，从一丛树木后面，走出一个人。{w}\n那人身上披着斗篷，缓缓将它褪下，落到地上。

column5: It's about time.\nHiding in fright isn't really my style.\nSorry to worry you, everybody. I really am.
column6: 也该出来了。\n因为害怕而躲躲藏藏可不是我的风格。\n抱歉让各位担心了。真的。

column5: Pro and Ulric high five, and then give each other a tight embrace.
column6: 普洛和乌尔里克击了个掌，然后紧紧拥抱了彼此。

column5: Yeah, putting on this act was getting hard!\nLet's get on that ship, and tell everybody our secret.
column6: 是啊，演这出戏越来越难了！\n我们上船吧，把我们的秘密告诉大家。

column5: Before Ulric can even act, he's bombarded with hugs from our comrades.{w}\nThe man they thought was killed in cold blood, now stands before them.{w}\nI'm shocked, confused, but also a little relieved. What's going on, here...?
column6: 乌尔里克还没反应过来，就被战友们的拥抱包围了。{w}\n那个他们以为被冷血杀害的人，此刻就站在他们面前。{w}\n我震惊、困惑，但也稍微松了口气。这到底是怎么回事……？

column5: Hey now, cut that out.\nIt's nice to know that you missed me, at least.\nBut we should get going before they know I'm still alive.
column6: 嘿，别这样。\n至少知道你们想我了，这很好。\n但我们得在他们知道我还没死之前赶紧走。

column5: Yeah, if they find out we cheated, they'll invalidate the victory.\nI know you want an explanation, so let's talk about it on the ship.\nWe should set sail right away, so nobody catches on to us.
column6: 是啊，要是他们发现我们作弊，就会让这场胜利作废。\n我知道你们想要个解释，那我们就上船再说。\n我们得立刻启航，别让任何人察觉。

column5: You can come out now.
column6: 你可以出来了。

column5: And then, from behind a group of trees, steps out a man.{w}\nThey have a cloak covering their body, which they slowly drop to the ground.
column6: 接着，从一丛树木后面，走出一个人。{w}\n那人身上披着斗篷，缓缓将它褪下，落到地上。

column5: Oh man, it's about time.\nThere's nothing I hate more than hiding.\nSorry for worrying all of you, but we had to do it.
column6: 哎，也该出来了。\n我最讨厌的就是躲藏。\n抱歉让你们所有人都担心了，但我们不得不这么做。

column5: Pro and Ulric high five, and then give each other a tight embrace.
column6: 普洛和乌尔里克击了个掌，然后紧紧拥抱了彼此。

column5: Yeah, I'm not the best actor, you know.\nI think people were starting to see through our lies.
column6: 是啊，你知道的，我可不是什么好演员。\n我觉得人们开始看穿我们的谎言了。

column5: Before Pro can do anything else, he's bombarded with hugs from our comrades.{w}\nThe man they thought was killed in cold blood, now stands before them.{w}\nI'm shocked, confused, but also a little relieved. What was going on, here?
column6: 普洛还没来得及做别的，就被战友们的拥抱包围了。{w}\n那个他们以为被冷血杀害的人，此刻就站在他们面前。{w}\n我震惊、困惑，但也稍微松了口气。这到底是怎么回事？

column5: Hey, come on, cut it out...!\nIt's enough to know you missed me.\nBut we really need to get going. Fast.
column6: 嘿，行了，别这样……！\n知道你们想我了就够了。\n但我们真的得走了。快点。

column5: Yeah. If they find out we cheated, we're done for.\nI know you want an explanation, so let's talk about it on the ship.\nWe should set sail right away, so nobody catches on to us.
column6: 是啊。要是他们发现我们作弊，我们就完了。\n我知道你们想要个解释，那我们就上船再说。\n我们得立刻启航，别让任何人察觉。

column5: They start to walk toward the ship, but Damek stops them.
column6: 他们开始朝船走去，但达梅克叫住了他们。

column5: Wait — you cheated...?\nHow are we going to break this news to our new partner?\nIf {i}they{/i} find out, they might just break off our Alliance.
column6: 等等——你们作弊了……？\n我们要怎么把这个消息告诉我们的新盟友？\n要是{i}他们{/i}发现了，说不定会直接跟我们断绝同盟。

column5: It worked out in their benefit, so I doubt they'd care.\nLet's get going, we'll explain the story on our way home.
column6: 结果对他们有利，所以我觉得他们不会在意。\n走吧，回程路上我们会把来龙去脉解释清楚。

column5: I'm so confused...
column6: 我完全糊涂了……

column5: Don't worry about it, Damek.\nWe made it out of this without any casualties, really.\nA few members of the reserve forces died, but that's it.
column6: 别担心，达梅克。\n说真的，我们这次脱身，没有任何伤亡。\n后备部队里有几个人死了，仅此而已。

column5: Thankfully, none of our Seers fell in combat.\nWe have more strength than ever before. That's what matters.\nAttacking Balteus will be as easy as the snap of a finger...!
column6: 幸好，我们的先知没有一个战死。\n我们比以往任何时候都更强大。这才是关键。\n进攻巴尔泰乌斯会易如反掌……！

column5: Thankfully, none of the Monarch Vessels fell in combat.\nWe have more strength than ever before. That's what matters.\nAttacking Balteus will be as easy as the snap of a finger...!
column6: 幸好，君王容器没有一个战死。\n我们比以往任何时候都更强大。这才是关键。\n进攻巴尔泰乌斯会易如反掌……！

column5: Alright, then. I trust you.\nBut you better have a good explanation for this.\nLet's get going, everybody. We have a long voyage home.
column6: 那好吧。我相信你们。\n但你们最好有个像样的解释。\n大家走吧。我们回家的航程还很长。

column5: Damek, Ulric and Pro all get on the ship.{w}\nI start to walk over with Howl, Valessa, and Fortaime.{w}\nThey seem happy, but just as confused as I am.
column6: 达梅克、乌尔里克和普洛都上了船。{w}\n我和豪尔、瓦莱莎、福泰姆一起朝船走去。{w}\n他们看起来很高兴，但也和我一样困惑。

column5: Cheating is not something we agree with.\nSuch tactics are what our current enemy employs.\nThis journey seems to be changing all of your values.
column6: 作弊不是我们所认同的。\n这种手段正是我们现在的敌人所用的。\n这趟旅程似乎正在改变你们所有人的价值观。

column5: But he's still alive...! That's great news.\nI was really freaking out, I didn't know what to do.\nDon't tell me you think it would be better if he was dead...
column6: 但他还活着……！这是天大的好消息。\n我当时真的吓坏了，不知道该怎么办。\n别告诉我你觉得他死了会更好……

column5: Maybe. Means to an end, we suppose.\nThe enemy likely thinks the same way.
column6: 也许吧。我们猜，是为了达到目的的手段。\n敌人多半也是这么想的。

column5: With that, he walks away and gets on the ship.{w}\nValessa and Fortaime both turn to me, happy.
column6: 说完，他走开上了船。{w}\n瓦莱莎和福泰姆都转向我，满脸喜悦。

column5: Let's go find out what they have to say.\nI'm also curious about that other man we restrained.\nThere's so much going on right now, I can barely think.
column6: 我们去听听他们怎么说吧。\n我也很好奇我们控制住的那个人。\n现在发生的事太多了，我几乎无法思考。

column5: Yeah, I want to figure everything out.\nI was worried we'd be attacking Balteus without all of our friends.\nBut to know he's still alive...? I can't even begin to describe the relief.
column6: 是啊，我想把一切都弄清楚。\n我原本担心我们会缺了朋友去进攻巴尔泰乌斯。\n但知道他居然还活着……？那种如释重负的感觉，我简直无法形容。

column5: We make our way to the deck of the ship, but Valessa's words stick with me.{w}\nEverything was moving so fast, I almost didn't know what was going on.{w}\nThankfully, we had a long trip home to get everything figured out.
column6: 我们走向船的甲板，但瓦莱莎的话一直萦绕在我心头。{w}\n一切都发生得太快，我几乎搞不清状况。{w}\n幸好，我们有一段漫长的归程可以把一切弄清楚。

column5: And that was my goal. We'd get back to Mazeo with no questions left unanswered.{w}\nNo matter how shocking the answers were, and whether or not I regretted learning them.{w}\nWe seemed to be running on everybody's agenda but my own. Everybody had their own plans.
column6: 而这就是我的目标。我们要回到马泽奥，不留下任何未解之谜。{w}\n不管那些答案有多么惊人，也不管我是否会后悔知道它们。{w}\n我们似乎一直在按所有人的议程行事，唯独没有我的。每个人都有自己的盘算。

column5: It was time for that to change.
column6: 是时候改变这一点了。

column5: When we all get on the ship, it starts to set sail within moments.{w}\nIt seems that Ulric and Pro want to expedite our departure from Alarinthia.{w}\nThey continue to look at us, with smiles on their faces. To themselves, they had succeeded.
column6: 我们所有人上船后，船片刻间就启航了。{w}\n看来乌尔里克和普洛想让我们尽快离开阿拉林西亚。{w}\n他们脸上挂着笑容，不断看着我们。在他们自己看来，他们已经成功了。

column5: But in what, exactly...?{w}\nThat's what I demand to know, as I step forward.{w}\nIf I was in charge, I couldn't have them plotting behind my back.
column6: 但究竟是在什么上成功了……？{w}\n这正是我上前一步，要求弄清楚的。{w}\n既然是我主事，我就不能容忍他们在我背后谋划。

column5: Everybody gathers around to listen as our ship gently rocks back and forth.{w}\nThough relieved that there were no real casualties, we needed to know what we got into.{w}\nIf they wanted to leave so fast, was it so bad that we could never come back to Alarinthia...?
column6: 船轻轻摇晃着，大家聚拢过来倾听。{w}\n尽管为没有真正的伤亡而松了口气，我们仍需要知道我们卷入了什么。{w}\n如果他们想这么快离开，难道真糟到我们再也回不了阿拉林西亚了吗……？

column5: Whoa, it's not that bad. Trust me.\nBut it's definitely the biggest score of my life.\nI mean, swindle an entire nation? Amazing.
column6: 哇，没那么严重。相信我。\n但这绝对是我人生中最大的一笔收获。\n我是说，骗过一整个国家？太妙了。

column5: He continues talking — his pride apparent.
column6: 他继续说着——得意之情溢于言表。

column5: It all started after the attack on our HQ.\nDamek cheated death, and we rose from the ashes.\nThen, we were going to Alarinthia, where I knew we'd be fighting.
column6: 一切都从我们总部遭到袭击之后开始。\n达梅克死里逃生，我们从灰烬中崛起。\n接着，我们要去阿拉林西亚，我知道我们在那里会有一战。

column5: So I thought, what if we could cheat death again, but to {i}our{/i} advantage?\nThere was so much room for error, that we stepped in to even the odds.\nI knew that Ulric would side with Vivien regardless, so I went to him.
column6: 所以我想，要是我们能再次死里逃生，而且是对{i}我们{/i}有利呢？\n其中有太多变数，于是我们插手进来，把胜算扳平。\n我知道乌尔里克无论如何都会站在薇薇安那边，所以我找上了他。

column5: I didn't want to work with Pro at first, it seemed like a plan doomed to failure.\nCould we really cheat an entire nation, right in front of their own eyes...?\nObviously, it sounds impossible. But Pro was pretty insistent.
column6: 一开始我不想和普洛合作，那计划看起来注定失败。\n我们真能在整个国家眼皮底下骗过他们吗……？\n显然，这听起来不可能。但普洛非常坚持。

column5: He came up with a solid plan. I'd fight with Vivien, and he'd fight with Draycu.\nIf we were both on opposing teams, we could throw the battle in any direction.\nSo that's what we did — we ensured victory for the side [firstname] chose.
column6: 他想出了一个周密的计划。我和薇薇安并肩作战，他和德雷库并肩作战。\n如果我们分处对立的两队，就能把战局引向任何一方。\n于是我们就这么做了——我们确保了[firstname]所选那一边的胜利。

column5: It was easy enough to manipulate Draycu.\nI mean, he thought he was the one manipulating us.\nBut it was my plan all along to fight by his side.
column6: 操控德雷库轻而易举。\n我是说，他还以为是他在操控我们。\n但和他并肩作战本来就是我的计划。
